'''Princess Dee Kinsington''' is a [[Sim]] who appeared in some promotional material for ''[[The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy]]''. She can be downloaded from the [[Gallery]] as part of the [[Fashion Forward Nobles household]], along with [[Carlos Rodriguez]], [[Queen Camila Lytle]], [[Edward Webb]], [[Donald Moulton]], [[Megan Mueller]], [[Valerie Boles]], and [[Steve Kinsington]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/C8G%2BHcSpSaO1l%2FSFuCNihg Fashion Forward Nobles by Maxis]</ref>

In the nobility gameplay trailer, Princess Dee can be seen [[Frog (The Sims 4)|kissing a frog]]. In one reality, the frog turns into a prince and she gains status, from a Dame to a Countess. In the other reality, she is caught kissing the frog by her people, leading to a scandal. She is forced to abdicate the throne and is eventually killed by a [[Death#Types of deaths|cuckoo clock malfunction]]. In the same trailer, her son [[Steve Kinsington]] rejects the offer of being her heir.<ref>{{cite web|author=The Sims|date=22 January 2026|title=The Sims 4 Royalty & Legacy <nowiki>|</nowiki> Nobility Gameplay Trailer|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VINAZIyifiA|work=YouTube|access-date=27 July 2026}}</ref>

If placed in the world, she and her son are not actually related. When first played, she is 39 days away from becoming an [[elder]].

She can be downloaded from the [[Gallery]] as part of the [[Casual Nobles household]], along with [[Dayna Refuerzo]], [[Marielle Messer]], [[Yusuf Messer]], [[Theo Phelps]], [[Nigel Godfrey]], [[Patrice Herron]], and [[Deonte Goodman]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/pFm4qtzrSce6MT6UCLK0%2FA Casual Nobles by Maxis]</ref>

In the nobility gameplay trailer, Mabel can be seen with a partner and a baby, but they are not available on the Gallery.<ref>{{cite web|author=The Sims|date=22 January 2026|title=The Sims 4 Royalty & Legacy <nowiki>|</nowiki> Nobility Gameplay Trailer|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VINAZIyifiA|work=YouTube|access-date=27 July 2026}}</ref> While she wears a crown, she is not employed in the [[noble]] career.

==Trivia==
*Xian either refers to {{WP|Xian|one of the oldest cities in China}} or the Taoist concept of {{WP|Xian (Taoism)|Xian}}, which refers to entities who have attained immortality and supernatural or magical abilities later in life, with a connection to the heavenly realms inaccessible to mortals.

As an [[adult]], she goes by the name Ophelia Specter and lives in the Meetinghouse in [[Deadtree]]. Much like in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', her home features a graveyard. She reveals to the player that she moved there as soon as she could, not knowing that the place would be haunted. Another Deadtree resident, [[Pita Florica]], claims that the Meetinghouse is rightfully hers and asks the player to investigate. As it turns out, the Meetinghouse really belongs to Ophelia through her mother's will. Ophelia's secrets from ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)]]'': *[[File:Personal.png|30x30px]] '''(Personal):''' Ophelia no longer uses internet dating... "I live in a graveyard" doesn't attract the best men. *[[File:Intimate.png|30x30px]] '''(Intimate):''' Ophelia has trouble sleeping without the soothing wail of a frenzied ghost. *[[File:Dark.png|30x30px]] '''(Dark):''' Ophelia is so absent minded, she's been known to find her keys, but lose her house! *[[File:Secret.png|30x30px]] '''(To Heir is Human):''' Ophelia knocked over the bookcase where her mother's will was kept. {{Personality type|Water}} Unlike her PC counterpart, Ophelia is primarily interested in Sci-Fi, Weather, and Paranormal. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{SkillTable |creativity = 10}} |-|Interests= {{PSPInterestTable|ghost|sun|moonfull|alien|aliens|moonbeast}} |tab4 = The Sims 2 |text4 = {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Ophelia Nigmos |image = |-|Default = [[File:Ophelia Nigmos.png|250px]] |-|Refreshed = [[File:Ophelia Nigmos In-game.png|250px]] |caption = Ophelia's hobbies include hypochondria and monitoring the air quality. She worries about the future... and the past... and the present. |sex = Female |game = The Sims 2 |age = Teen |school = Public School |grade = A |asp = Family |sign = Virgo |hair = Blonde |eye = Green |skin = Dark |body = Fit |family = [[Specter family|Nigmos family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[Creon Nigmos]], [[Willow Nigmos]]|Both Deceased}} |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Johnny Smith]]|Boyfriend}} |maritalstatus = Dating |roommates = [[Olive Specter]] |play = Playable |neighbor = Strangetown}} ==Biography== At the start of the game, Ophelia's parents [[Creon Nigmos|Creon]] and [[Willow Nigmos|Willow]] have both drowned. As a result, she lives with her aunt, [[Olive Specter]]. Although she is related to [[Nervous Subject]], they do not know one another when [[Strangetown]] is first played. Ophelia is [[voice]]d by Thessaly Lerner. When she becomes an [[adult]], she will be voiced by the late Gerri Lawlor. Ophelia has blonde hair in braids, wears a grey tank top with a black tie with white stripes, and blue jeans with colored sneakers. She's [[going steady]] with [[Johnny Smith]] and is also friends with [[Ripp Grunt]]. When first played, she is 2 days away from becoming an adult. If ''[[The Sims 2: University|University]]'' is installed, she will qualify for two [[scholarship]]s: the Orphaned Sims Assistance Fund and the SimCity Scholar's Grant. At first glance, every ancestor of Ophelia has either brown eyes or grey eyes. However, Ophelia's parents both have [[:Category:Sims who have a corrupted face|glitched appearances]]. In both of their original thumbnails, they have brown eyes. Her mother, Willow, will have green eyes if she is resurrected. Her father, Creon, will have light blue eyes if he is resurrected. This situation also occurs with [[Cordelia Capp]]; she has grey eyes and eyebrows when resurrected, even though her original thumbnail shows neither of these features. Like many other [[Strangetown]] residents, Ophelia has corrupt hidden family flags in her relationship data for [[Jenny Smith|Jenny]], [[Johnny Smith|Johnny]], and [[Jill Smith]], as well as [[Ripp Grunt]]. Judging from the storytelling photos in the game, Ophelia's facial structure likely went through a number of changes before the game was released. She appears to resemble her mother strongly, but was likely given a new face as a large amount of data became corrupted over time. A similar situation happens with many living Sims in [[Veronaville]]. Prior to the release of ''The Sims 2'', her original name was '''Ophelia Specter'''. This was changed at some point during development. '''Cassandra Goth''' ({{IPAc-en|k|ə|ˈ|s|æ|n|d|r|ə|_|ɡ|ä|θ}}) is a pre-made, playable [[Sim]] who first appeared in ''[[The Sims]]''. She is the daughter of [[Mortimer Goth|Mortimer]] and [[Bella Goth]] and grew up at [[5 Sim Lane]]. She later moved to [[Pleasantview]] alongside her parents. Between ''The Sims'' and ''[[The Sims 2]]'', she got a younger brother, [[Alexander Goth|Alexander]]. Shortly before the start of ''The Sims 2,'' her mother, Bella, went missing, having been [[alien abduction|abducted]] by [[alien]]s, and hasn't yet returned.

In the [[alternate universe]] of ''[[The Sims 4]]'', Cassandra lives at [[Ophelia Villa]] in [[Willow Creek]], alongside her father, Mortimer, her mother, Bella, and her younger brother, Alexander.

==Biography==
Cassandra appears in ''[[The Sims 4]]'' alternate continuity as a [[teen]], living with her parents and [[Alexander Goth|younger brother]] in the [[Ophelia Villa]] in [[Willow Creek]]. She is the heiress of the Goth [[dynasty]] and her social media handle is @thegothgirl.

When first played, Cassandra is a [[school|high school]] student with a C grade. She is 21 days away from becoming a [[young adult]]. She has her hair in black pigtails and wears black square glasses, a black sweater, a black and gray checkered skirt, gray and white knee-high socks, and black boots with white laces.

Cassandra and [[Goth family|her family]] were given an official makeover shortly after the release of [[The Sims 4/Patch 129|patch 129]].<ref>{{cite web|title=The Sims 4  Delivery Express: NEW DELIVERY! (May 25th, 2022)|url=https://simscommunity.info/2022/05/25/the-sims-4-delivery-express-new-delivery-may-25th-2022/|first=Jovan|last=Jovic|publisher=Sims Community|date=May 25, 2022|accessdate=May 25, 2022}}</ref> The original version of the family is available on the [[Gallery]] for players who prefer their pre-patch appearances.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/eezQYekZEeyER0LIjIhxIA Classic Goths by Maxis]</ref>

=====Alternate versions=====
There is also another version of the [[Goth family|Goths]] on [[Maxis]]' [[gallery]] page, under the name [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/2ZgQhfx1EeuMvS4s5iFApA New Home New Goths], with outfits from the ''[[The Sims 4: Dream Home Decorator]]'' [[Content pack#Game pack|game pack]]. In the trailer for this game pack, the Goths appear in these outfits to match the home renovation they receive.

The refreshed version of Cassandra was given a makeover with assets from ''[[Kits for The Sims 4|The Sims 4: Goth Galore Kit]]'', on which she is featured on the cover. This version lives with a [[young adult]] [[Lilith Pleasant]], and another [[Sim]] named [[Grey Reed]].

==Biography==
In the 25 years that have theoretically passed between ''[[The Sims]]'' and ''[[The Sims 2]]'', Cassandra makes her reappearance, living in [[165 Sim Lane|Goth Manor]] with her aging father, [[Mortimer Goth|Mortimer]], and her bright younger brother, [[Alexander Goth|Alexander]]. She has grown into an [[adult]] and honors her last name. She She rarely smiles, according to her bio. Cassandra is [[voice]]d by the late Gerri Lawlor.

She is engaged to [[marriage|marry]] [[Don Lothario]] and is madly in [[relationship|love]] with him, but does not realize—or appears to be unaware—that he is also involved with several other women. She is also unaware of the crush that her neighbor [[Darren Dreamer]] has on her.

Like her father, Mortimer, she works in the [[Science#The Sims 2|Science]] [[career]]. Cassandra is an adult and will become an [[elder]] in 26 days. She is generally shy and neat, and is occasionally playful; her favorite activities are playing [[piano]] and reading. Cassandra wants to have a [[family relationships|family]] and live a normal life.

When the [[Goth family|Goths]] are first played in ''The Sims 2'', Cassandra and Don are in the back garden, and a game tip instructs that the player should give Don a [[Romantic (social type)|romantic]] gesture to spark things off. It then tells the player to marry them, which can be achieved by simply clicking the [[wedding arch]], followed by the interaction option of "Get married". 

In these circumstances, Don usually leaves Cassandra at the altar, leaving her in a bad mood and, if ''[[The Sims 2: Nightlife|Nightlife]]'' or later is installed, [[Fury|furious]] with Don. However, it is possible to have Don marry her by simply getting the [[relationship]] higher and doing more than just a kiss (getting the relationship to 100).

She is close friends with [[Mary-Sue Pleasant]] and has been since they were [[child]]ren. One of the [[Pleasant family]]'s storytelling pictures suggests that Cassandra was the Maid of Honor at Mary-Sue's [[marriage|wedding]]. 

Strangely, while Cassandra is a Cancer in ''The Sims'', she is a Virgo in ''The Sims 2''. If ''[[The Sims 2: FreeTime|FreeTime]]'' is installed, her pre-destined [[hobby]] will be [[Tinkering]], due to her shy [[personality]].

If Cassandra is invited over by Darren when first playing the [[Dreamer family]], there is a high chance that she will [[flirt]] with him [[Autonomous reaction|autonomously]]. If this happens, then she will fall in love with Darren, which will instantly cause her to be [[affair|cheating]] on Don Lothario, with him (unless the player breaks up Cassandra's and Don's engagement prior).

==Biography==
In ''[[The Sims]]'' for [[The Sims (console)|console]], Cassandra lives with her parents, [[Mortimer Goth|Mortimer]] and [[Bella Goth|Bella]], at [[5 Sim Avenue]]. She is a B student. 

She shares a 20+ [[relationship]] with both her parents. She likes to play with her [[toy]]s, play the [[piano]], feed the [[fish]], and mourn at the [[gravestone|tombstones]]. 

Cassandra is a B student in the console version but an A student in the PC version.

With [[free will]] on, Cassandra and [[Goth family|her family]] will only mourn at the tombstones, even if they are in a bad [[mood]].

*She may be based on/a spoof of Wednesday Addams from ''The Addams Family'', due to her appearance and [[personality]]. 
*Although she is named Carin Spökh in the Swedish version of ''[[The Sims]]'', Cornelia's bio still refers to her as Cassandra. This was most likely a translation error.

While her parents, [[Daniel Pleasant|Daniel]] and [[Mary-Sue Pleasant]] {{nee|Oldie}}, appear on their honeymoon in ''[[TheSims3.com#The Sims 3 Store|The Sims 3 Store]]'' world [[Sunlit Tides]], Lilith and her twin sister [[Angela Pleasant|Angela]] have not yet been conceived, but can be born in-game if the player decides to have Daniel and Mary-Sue [[Pregnancy|try for a baby]].

==Biography==
In this [[Alternate universe|timeline]], older versions of Lilith and [[Angela Pleasant|Angela]] are present in ''[[The Sims 4: Discover University]]'' as residents of [[Britechester]]. 

Lilith is a [[young adult]], and is 26 days away from becoming an [[adult]]. She is enrolled in her first term at [[Foxbury Institute]]. Her [[relationship]] with her sister is more positive than in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', with them being acquaintances instead of enemies. Despite this, both Lilith and Angela have the same level of [[painting]] [[skill]] and possibly an affinity for art, which seems to mean they still share some common ground and are at least a little bit alike.

In this appearance, Lilith has a black cat tattoo on the back of her left arm and also has an eyebrow and nose piercing.

The young adult Lilith was given a makeover with assets from ''[[Kits for The Sims 4|The Sims 4: Goth Galore Kit]]'', which features her on the cover. This version lives with a [[teen]] [[Cassandra Goth]] and another Sim named [[Grey Reed]] in [[The Goth Galore Trio household]].

Furthermore, she is not acquainted with [[Dirk Dreamer]], and if they meet, they cannot [[dating|date]] until Lilith ages into a [[young adult]]. 

Both Angela and Lilith will turn into young adults in 12 days. Lilith carries incomplete [[homework]] in her [[inventory]] and has no [[skill]]s. She also has a tattoo of three black butterflies on her upper back, which is visible between her choker and shirt.

==Biography==
Lilith resides in the [[215 Sim Lane|Pleasant house]] in [[Pleasantview]] with her parents, [[Daniel Pleasant|Daniel]] and [[Mary-Sue Pleasant|Mary-Sue]], and twin sister [[Angela Pleasant|Angela]]. She and [[Lucy Burb]] are cousins. According to Lilith's [[memories]], she and [[Dirk Dreamer]] were [[child]]hood friends and are now [[dating]]. Their parents' memories indicate that she is the younger of the Pleasant twins, though that is not explicitly stated. When first playing the [[family relationships|family]], the twins are both 10 days away from becoming [[adult]]s. Lilith is [[voice]]d by Thessaly Lerner. When she becomes an adult, she will be voiced by the late Gerri Lawlor.

Lilith is also the granddaughter of [[Jeff Pleasant|Jeff]] and [[Diane Pleasant]] (her father's parents), and [[Herb Oldie|Herb]] and [[Coral Oldie]] (her mother's adoptive parents). Jeff and Diane [[death|passed away]] when Lilith was a [[toddler]], though she has no memory of their deaths.

She and her twin are, or at least appear to be, complete opposites, emphasized in their choice of clothes and room decoration. While Angela dresses in a light green sundress, Lilith wears a black gothic dress with black boots, and has black spike collars on her neck and wrists. Lilith's room is "dark", with a dark red [[carpet]] and stone walls, and no [[computer]] (or even [[surface|desk]]); contrastingly, Angela's room is a bright shade of pink with a computer in her room. While it's not certain why Lilith's room is more sparsely decorated than Angela's, Lilith's things are generally pricier, costing between §140 and §1,200. However, it does appear that each twin was allowed to decorate her room as she chose.

Lilith's memories strongly suggest that, when she was young, her parents favored Angela over her, since, unlike her sister, she was never taught her [[toddler skill]]s. No reason for this is given, but it likely contributed to her bad [[relationship]] with her parents and her sister. She considers herself to have been treated unfairly, and some players think Angela may be the reason, thus making her slightly hostile toward her sister.

Despite Lilith and Angela appearing to be polar opposites, the two share the [[Popularity]] [[Aspiration (The Sims 2)|aspiration]] and a very similar [[personality]], though Angela is a little bit neater, nicer, and more playful. Lilith's [[genetics]] are exactly like Angela's, except for having thinner eyebrows.

Lilith starts with no visible [[skill]]s (though she may roll [[Wants and fears|wants]] to gain some) and poor grades, though the player still has time to raise her grades before she ages up, if they wish.

Lilith hasn't met Dirk's father, [[Darren Dreamer|Darren]], and vice versa. The reason for this is unknown, but some players speculate that it could be so Lilith doesn't have a repeat of the trouble her sister's boyfriend is currently undergoing ([[Dustin Broke|Dustin]] and Daniel are enemies at the start of the game).

Her name may be a reference to Lilith, the queen of the dark. Seeing as the name Lilith is translated as Night Monster or Night Creature, it may be another reference, as Lilith is gothic and prefers dark things to the cute ones that her twin sister, Angela, likes.

'''Rodrigo De Pablo''' is a pre-made Sim in ''[[The Sims 4]]''. He can be found in the [[The Sims 4 Gallery|Gallery]] with his roommates, [[Cordelia Thebe]], [[Chaz MacFreeling]], [[Long John Buttercups]], [[Bob The Butler]], and [[Matilda The Cook]], where they were uploaded by [[Maxis]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/GCCFn7pBEemETu5z4J7HyQ Princess Cordelia by Maxis]</ref> It is said that Princess Cordelia enjoyed the company of pirates, possibly implying that Rodrigo and the other pirates in the household are intended to be her love interests.

Rodrigo is stated to be Princess Cordelia's third pirate boyfriend in the description of the 'Captain Rodrigo De Pablo Couch'. He and Cordelia spent their time together on a submarine named 'Eppsilon', as revealed by the cask named after him.

There are four [[buy mode]] items named after him: a cask, a dining chair, an ottoman, and a couch. He is very accident-prone, and all of the item descriptions involve separate stories of him becoming injured. According to his [[Collecting (The Sims 4)|message in a bottle]], Rodrigo's boat, the Peggy Leg, was sunk in an incident involving kelp, a [[Mermaid]], and a [[dolphin]]. This ties in with him having the [[Clumsy (The Sims 4)|clumsy]] trait.

Few realize the famed Captain Rodrigo De Pablo (a pirate) was also one of the greatest lepidopterists of his time! He was rather clumsy and stumbled upon a host of new butterfly species (on accident, mind you) when sailing the world and visiting distant shores. In total, he found and named over 14 new butterflies, but his favorite was the Cordelian Butterfly, which he named for his love, Princess Cordelia of House Thebe. He wrote, "As this butterfly flutters by, its wings echo the lilac depths of her gaze and the silken grace of her gown, a tribute to my cherished princess."<ref>The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits</ref>

The "Bob the Butler Fancy Sculpture" states that Princess Cordelia had to fire Bob after moving from her palace into a submarine with 48 rooms. She made the sculpture to remember him by.

**It's also possible that the woman Matilda writes about is [[Cordelia Thebe|Princess Cordelia]].

'''Malcolm Landgraab''' (or '''Malcolm Landgrabb'''{{Vgversion|TSC}}{{Vgversion|BO}}) is a pre-made [[Sim]] who appears throughout various games of [[The Sims (series)|''The Sims'' series]]. He is the first ever Landgraab featured in The Sims universe (but not the earliest known member of his dynasty), since his first apparition in "[[w:c:simcity:SimCity 3000|SimCity 3000]]". Since then, he has been featured in ''[[The Sims (console)|The Sims for console]]'', ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out for console]]'', ''[[The Sims 3]]'', [[The Sims 3 (console)|''The Sims 3 for console'']], ''[[The Sims 4]]'', [[The Sims Mobile|The Sims Mobile]] and [[The Sims FreePlay|The Sims Freeplay]].

He is a business tycoon and antagonist in ''The Sims'' for console and ''The Sims Bustin' Out''. He is one of the most prominent members of the [[Landgraab family]] and the father of [[Mimi Landgraab|Mimi]] and [[Dudley Landgraab|Dudley]].

Malcolm is the son and heir of [[Geoffrey Landgraab|Geoffrey]] and [[Nancy Landgraab|Nancy]], who belong to the rich and powerful [[Landgraab family]]. The connection between this branch of the family and the one in ''[[The Sims 2: Open for Business]]'' is unspecified, but he and [[Malcolm Landgraab III|Malcolm III]] may be contemporaries.

==Biography==
Malcolm appears in ''[[The Sims 3]]'' as the only child of [[Geoffrey Landgraab|Geoffrey]] and [[Nancy Landgraab]]. He is 4 days away from becoming a [[teen]] at the start of the game and lives in [[Sunset Valley]] with his parents. He would presumably be an [[elder]], or close to becoming one, by the time of ''[[The Sims 2]]'', but he does not appear in ''The Sims'' or ''The Sims 2.''

Malcolm is different from his parents, as he is a good, ambitious bookworm. However, Malcolm has more in common with his father, a family-oriented doctor, than with his mother, who is a snobby businesswoman.

Malcolm's biography indicates that he's unhappy with the thought of being groomed to be the heir of the immense family fortune. According to his mother's bio, Nancy often neglects Malcolm because she is overly concerned with her looks, job, and social life. In his relationship panel, Malcolm starts with a higher [[relationship]] with his father than with his mother.

Although his parents are rivals with the [[Alto Family|Alto family]], Malcolm seems to have no current conflict with their daughter, [[Holly Alto (Sunset Valley)|Holly]].

==Biography==
In ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out]]'', Malcolm wears a bicolor pelt stole with a white suit, a white chest open shirt, brown loafers, and a white top hat. When the player first visits [[Shiny Things Labs]], they will learn that Malcolm is the CEO of [[Shiny Things Inc.]] and that he is waiting for Vaughn and Makino to develop secret weapons, the "Rocket Gnome technology" they have to launch, as one of this level's goals. At [[The Octagon]] and at the [[Tinsel Bluffs]], the player finds out that Malcolm is also a senator and a movie producer, respectively.

Malcolm will go around [[SimValley]] and "repossess" things from Sims for not being able to pay rent or return his investments until he is defeated by the player's Sim and their [[Mom Landgraab|Mom]], who has divorced Malcolm and holds a grudge against him. The way the player can achieve this is by working their Sims' way up on the career path, moving into different houses, and achieving pre-decided goals in each different home.

When the player's Sim has almost reached the top of a career path, they will unlock a location called [[Malcolm's Mansion]]. When the player reaches the location, Malcolm will be standing on the path to the front door, and Mom then proceeds to "chase after Malcolm". After this, Malcolm runs off his property, leaving the player to bask in the glory of their new mansion. Malcolm is last seen in a cutscene on a cruise ship, where he is humiliated in various comical ways based on the player's career.

Malcolm first appears in ''[[w:c:simcity:SimCity 3000|SimCity 3000]]'' as the owner and sole employee of "Malcolm Landgraab Industries", a real-estate development and investment company that holds controlling interests in many large-scale projects throughout SimNation. Malcolm divides his time between a condominium in the city and a hacienda on the resort island of San Cordelia.'''

Malcolm’s dialogue suggests that he is a highly persuasive, quick-witted and self-assured negotiator. He rarely presents his proposals as straightforward business deals, instead framing them as exciting opportunities tied to civic pride, prestige, prosperity or political success. He appears keenly aware of other people’s motivations, frequently appealing to the mayor’s ego, public image and relationship with influential voters. His sense of humor is dry and often sarcastic, with a fondness for wordplay, double meanings and pointed remarks. While generally charming and polished in his approach, he can become openly condescending or cutting when challenged or refused, revealing a more arrogant and domineering side beneath his affable salesman persona.

Several of Malcolm's proposals reveal both his commercial instincts and his attitude toward wealth and influence. He promotes the construction of an exclusive country club and golf course as a mark that a city has “arrived,” explicitly suggesting that catering to the city's important voters may also benefit the mayor politically. He similarly backs a theme park, a defense contractor, a casino and a GigaMall, consistently emphasizing their profitability and economic value. His dialogue often treats consumerism and even politics as transactions; when the mayor approves the theme park, Malcolm immediately imagines Sims arriving with “wide smiles (and wide wallets).” 

Malcolm's business interests are not limited to real estate and leisure. One of his subsidiaries, Safety Flush Solutions, handles toxic-waste disposal and proposes constructing a plant to convert napalm, anthrax bacilli and nerve gas into deodorant and other harmless products. These ventures give him an ethically dubious edge, although the game depicts him less as an outright criminal than as an unabashed capitalist willing to monetize almost any civic need or opportunity.

}}

==Trivia==
[[File:ML slacker chance card.png|thumb|Malcolm mentioned in the Golf caddy chance card in ''The Sims 2''.]]
* In ''[[The Sims (console)|The Sims]]'' for console, Malcolm hints at his love for [[Mom Landgraab|Mom]] as during [[Reality Bites]]. If the player doesn't complete certain objectives after a few days, Malcolm will call the house and ask why they haven't completed the tasks, and he will mention that he learned this from their Mom, whom he calls lovely.

* Also in ''The Sims'' for console, if the "fish eye" cheat code is used to view the game in first-person, Malcolm can be seen sporting light red hair and a goatee at the end of the game when he comes to congratulate the player for his successful retirement party. This contrasts with promotional pictures of him or at the ending cutscene, where he has white hair and no goatee.

* In ''[[The Sims]]'', a high-tech [[refrigerator]] from [[Shiny Things Inc.]] is described as being the original idea of Malcolm Landgraab himself. "The brainchild of reclusive Shiny Things Inc. founder Malcolm Landgraab, the Freeze Secret exploits experimental cryogenic technology. Utilizing a combination of liquid sulfur dioxide and argon in a low-gravity vacuum, perishables are kept fresh for generations. High impact stainless steel and modern design make this the veritable ice queen of refrigeration."

* Malcolm is also mentioned in two [[chance card]]s in ''[[The Sims 2]]'':

* A chance card from the [[slacker]] career mentions that the purchase of Wrightway Toys by [[Landgraab Industries]] made Malcolm Landgraab the third richest Sim in [[SimCity]]. The player learns this information when working as a Golf Caddy for Malcolm.

* Another chance card in the [[culinary]] career reveals he is a very powerful Sim, able to get the player's Sim fired from their job as a Drive Trough Clerk thanks to his strong network.

* The Prima Strategy Guide for ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out]]'' claims that he has 0 nice points and 10 outgoing points. However, through Debug Mode, we can see he has 10 clean points, 3 outgoing and 4 for active, playful and nice.

* He has two personalities in ''[[The Sims (console)|The Sims]]'' : In the Musuem two-player mini-game, he is Sagittarius with Neat : 0 / Outgoing : 4 / Active : 10 / Playful : 7 /Nice : 4. In Get-a-Life mode, he is Leo with Neat : 4 / Outgoing : 10 / Active : 4 / Playful : 4 / Nice : 3. (datamined with ChatGPT in the game files "story.ngh", "PersonData" and "QuickDat.ARC").

* Also in ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out]]'', Malcolm cannot be killed off by most means as he will be resurrected by the [[Grim Reaper]]. However, if eaten by a [[Mutant plant]], he will die as the Grim Reaper will not show up. This is ill-advised, though, as any goals relating to him will become impossible to complete.

She is [[marriage|married]] to scientist [[Loki Beaker]]. ==Biography== ===Life leading up to The Sims 2=== According to the family biography, Circe and her husband use [[Nervous Subject]] for unusual scientific experiments, often at the expense of Nervous' health. She is [[voice]]d by the late Gerri Lawlor. Circe has a [[memories|memory]] of learning how to walk, and unlike most [[Sim]]s in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', no more memories of her [[toddler skill]]s. Her [[Xanthos Salamis|father]] was presumably absent from her life, as she only has a memory of his [[death]]. As a [[teen]], Circe "went steady" with childhood friend [[Vidcund Curious]]. However, she ended her [[relationship]] with him shortly thereafter. Although Vidcund continues to have feelings for her at the start of the game, she does not reciprocate his feelings. In addition to rejecting Vidcund, she also spurned his [[Pascal Curious|brother]]'s advances when he attempted to kiss her, which then started the Beaker/[[Curious family|Curious]] rivalry. Unusually for a pre-made character in ''The Sims 2'', she has pre-set friendships with a [[townie]] and a [[bartender]]: [[Abhijeet Cho]] and [[Meredith Lillard (Strangetown)|Meredith Lillard]], yet she does not remember meeting either of them. When the family is first played, Circe is 23 days away from being an [[elder]]. At the start of the game, the first thing Circe will do is go to work. She will usually, if not always, receive a promotion when she arrives home on the first day. Because Circe has reached level 4 of the Medicine career, she has a [[Career rewards#Medicine|Medicine career reward]] available for her to purchase, disregarding the fact that there is already one inside the house. Circe is extremely neat, midway between shy and outgoing, and very active, but she is completely serious and mean. Her husband's [[personality]] is similar to hers, though he is more outgoing and less active. Oddly enough, despite being a [[Fortune]] Sim with evident career ambitions, her [[Interest]]s suggest that she is actually heavily disinterested in Work, or at the very least, does not enjoy talking about it. Circe has a hidden [[Knowledge]] [[Aspiration (The Sims 2)|Aspiration]] token. She is unique in that her gender preferences are set to have equal values between male and female Sims, meaning she is likely bisexual. Circe, as well as [[Loki Beaker|her husband]], possesses corrupt relationship data found in SimPE, implying unknown family relations to several members of the Curious family, namely Vidcund, [[Kitty Curious|Kitty]], as well as [[Annie Hogleg|Annie]] and [[Hamm Hogleg]]. She also has inexplicable family relations to her [[townie]] friends [[Meredith Lillard (Strangetown)|Meredith Lillard]] and [[Abhijeet Cho]]. In some releases of ''[[The Sims 2]]'', players were able to click on a tile of the footpath outside their Sim's lot close to the end of their property.This option will not be available if ''[[The Sims 2: Nightlife|Nightlife]]'' or later is installed. There will be an interaction "leave world". Most Sims will leave the lot until the player exits and reloads it. Circe will attempt to leave the lot, but instead, she will reappear invisible. Her wedding ring will still be visible. Judging from her maiden name, "Salamis," her father is probably of Greek ancestry, while her mother, [[Grainne Salamis|Grainne]], is most likely of Irish and Welsh ancestry.
Circe was a Greek Goddess/Nymph/Witch who transformed Ulysses' men into pigs. Her last name, Salamis, is a Greco-Cypriot last name.
If ''[[The Sims 2: FreeTime]]'' is installed, Circe's predestined [[hobby]] will fittingly be [[Science (hobby)|Science]], because of her very neat and serious personality, along with her husband.
If ''[[The Sims 2: FreeTime|FreeTime]]'' is installed, she will be unable to call Meredith Lillard. The FreeTime patch does not fix this.
===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (PSP)=== In ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)|The Sims 2]]'' for PlayStation Portable, the Beakers are experimenting on [[Gimi Branko]], a garbage man kidnapped after the [[death]] of [[Nervous Subject|Nervous]]. When the player attempts to interact with the keypad outside Gimi's cell, either Loki or Circe stops them. If Circe stops them, she proposes a deal that they steal the secret patents that Loki has been hiding from her, stating that she intends to leave him once she obtains them. Upon receiving the patents, she clarifies that her intent to leave [[Loki Beaker|Loki]] was a lie, as the patents are in his name. She then gives the player some money, should they accept it. When intimidated, Circe will confess her [[affair]] with [[Doctor Dominic Newlow|Dominic Newlow]] to the player. Despite her [[relationship]] with Loki having evidently deteriorated, she expresses her confusion over it, as "[she] would never betray [her] husband," and that it was "the one thing [she] promised herself [she'd] never do". Insisting she was turning into Dominic's "obedient little worker ant" when in his presence, this serves as a clue to the player that Dominic is mind-controlling the citizens of [[Strangetown]]. In order to free Gimi from his captivity, the player must distract the Beakers by telling Loki about his wife's affair, which will ultimately cause a [[Fight (social type)|fight]] between them and allow the player to save Gimi. While working in the [[Medicine]] [[career]] in the PC version, what happened to Circe's occupation since then is unclear, as her biography only states she "runs the business end of the Beaker operation." Circe is light-skinned in the PSP version, while in the PC version, she is medium-skinned. The blue shirt that she wears in the PSP version can be found in a dresser in the Beaker household in the PC version. Circe's secrets in ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)|The Sims 2]]'' (PSP): *[[File:Personal.png|30px]]'''(Personal):''' Every time she sneezes, she forgets what happened in the last five minutes. *[[File:Intimate.png|30px]]'''(Intimate):''' Nothing excites her more than volunteering for crazy science experiments. *[[File:Dark.png|30px]]'''(Dark):''' Circe is secretly jealous of her husband's independence and distinction. Also, she hates his cooking. *[[File:Secret.png|30px]]'''(Circe's Affair):''' Circe has been sneaking off with Doctor Dominic Newlow! According to the game's data, she is interested in Food, Entertainment, and, in contrast to her PC counterpart, School and Fashion. ===Life leading up to The Sims 4=== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/DvqXGEaNEemHKnldy2Ruvw recreation] of Circe and her family was uploaded to [[gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on March 14, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. In this [[alternate universe|timeline]], she lives with her husband, [[Loki Beaker|Loki]], and [[Nervous Subject]], like in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', but also with Loki's children, [[Atom Beaker|Atom]] and [[Ceres Beaker|Ceres]]. Atom and Ceres had first appeared as [[adult]]s in [[Oasis Landing]], the sub-[[world]] shipped with ''[[The Sims 3: Into the Future]]'', alongside their [[Plumbot]] friend [[Cyclotron]]. Their biographies described them as twins who were genetically engineered by Loki. In this recreation, they are [[child]]ren wearing [[alien]] suits from ''[[The Sims 4: Get to Work]]''. The twins view Loki as their father, but only recognize Circe as their stepmother. ==Biography==
In the [[Timeline of events in The Sims series#Alternate timeline|alternate timeline]] of ''The Sims 4'', Nervous Subject is known under his real name, Nyon Specter. This name change is explained by him not getting experimented on by the [[Beaker family]] yet in the alternate timeline. Neither has he been taken away by the [[Social Worker]] in the alternate timeline. The developers described him as "pre-Nervous," suggesting it takes place before he met the Beakers and became Nervous Subject.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DfV7shwdWus</ref> 

Nyon is a [[teen]], 21 days away from becoming a [[young adult]]. He lives in [[Crow's Crossing]] with his mother, [[Olive Specter|Olive]], and her fiancé, [[Layne Coffin]]. His father is the [[Grim Reaper]], as he has the [[Trait (The Sims 4)|Grimborn]] inherited trait, a trait automatically assigned to Grim's offspring (along with a scythe-shaped birthmark on their necks).

In this incarnation, Nyon possesses a darker skin tone to more accurately reflect his mother's genes. He maintains his signature mohawk hairstyle, albeit slightly more textured, while his lips and nose have been made fuller as well. 

When spoken to using the '''Ravenwood Rumors''' interaction, Nyon will mention once having a close friend named [[Pascal Curious|Pascal]] who suddenly and inexplicably moved away and wiped his [[Social Bunny (The Sims 4)|Social Bunny]] profile, which made the young man feel alone. This, in turn, led him to develop a friendship with the local town ghosts [[Alice]] and [[Edith]], whom most Sims would be terrified of. He has a good relationship with his mother but a neutral one with his soon-to-be stepfather, with a slight dip into the red. In fact, Nyon mentions he finds Layne weird, calling him a "creep".

==Social==
===[[file:Ravenwood Rumors.png|30px|link=]] Ravenwood Rumors===
Nyon, like other citizens of Ravenwood, has a special interaction called ''Ravenwood Rumors'' that reveals tidbits of lore relating to himself, his ancestry, or the town's history. Depending on your relationship level with Nyon, different secrets will be revealed.

====0-32 Relationship Points====
*"Hey, did you know you can catch these really cool Death Frogs around [[Ravenwood]]? I have the best luck in the cemetery. I love frogs, y'know. My mom jokes about how I'm a big collector of things. You can catch me around sometimes at festivals, even. Hit me up at Ravenwood Family Day and we'll talk frog."
*"My [[Layne Coffin|future stepfather]] is such a weirdo. Explain this: one day, the Sim's out by the crypt in [[Crow's Crossing]] looking at the gravesite for one of my mom's dead husbands. What is that all about? I saw him pat the headstone and smile affectionately. Creep alert!"

====33-65 Relationship Points====
*"Everybody seems to have theories about who my real dad is, like it's their business. The funny thing is, sometimes when I'm walking around, I'll see a weird reflection of a black cloak behind me. I feel a really strange tie to the idea of death and reaping. Wait, not creepy like that, I mean...well, just the idea of Grim is something, huh?"
*"The other day, the TV was on the fritz and it electrocuted me. Out of nowhere, there's Layne just standing there saying, "Watch yourself, kid, you'll die of electrocution if you're not careful" in this dreamy voice. I wonder if all his little fans know that the eccentric musician act is absolutely not an act."
*"[[Zelmira Gomes|Zelmira]] got way into that [[Tarot cards|tarot]] stuff a while back and got me all interested in the Order of Lenore stuff. You know about that, right? It was appealing to me, cuz I feel like I'm just always in some random danger that I can't predict or understand. Tarot gives me a sense of order, I think? Or it makes things feel less chaotic. Whatever, I just like it a lot. You've gotten cards and seen the tomes around Ravenwood and all that, right?"

====66-100 Relationship Points====
*"It probably seems weird but since there’s a lot of, uh, death in my family over time, even before I was around, I end up feeling pretty close to death. I mean, [[Olive Specter|mom]]’s career kinda adds to that. But what I mean is, I’m in those crypts a lot just wandering around and thinking. I’d say it’s a great place to get away from my soon-to-be-stepdad, but I can’t tell you how often I see him leaving the crypts right when I’m stopping by."
*"I’ve honestly been really lonely since my best friend [[Pascal Curious|Pascal]] moved. I mean the guy basically disappeared off the map! Deleted his [[Social Bunny]] and everything. It’s how I ended up talking to [[Edith]] so much. I kept going for walks all by myself and trying to talk to her. Not like I had anyone else, you know?"

====Layne's Secret Confession====
Once the player discovers ''Layne Coffin'''s secret, Nyon will have this to say;
*"You found out the truth about Layne, right? That guy's supposed to be my new dad. Yeah right! Like I want touching father/son moments with a freak-o-rama who ''wants'' my mom to turn him into a ghost. Uh, let's not unpack anything you think you know about my mom, okay? We're not touching that."

==Biography==
Nervous is no longer around except as a restless ghost in the main bedroom of [[Bella Goth]]'s mansion, [[Espiritu Estate]]. [[Emily Emory]] tells the player that Nervous was always short on money and signed up as a test subject for the Beakers. One day, [[Loki Beaker]] kept him in a miserable condition and performed a test on Nervous with one of the machine (presumably the [[Eclectic and Enigmatic Energizer]] as shown in the PC version). Unfortunately the machine he used shocked him to death. After Nervous' death, the Beakers even kidnapped a garbage man, [[Gimi Branko]], for their tests. The player has to obtain a charm from his grave and give it to [[Annie Howell]] at Nighthowl Saloon. It is indicated that he fell in love with Annie and became her boyfriend, but the player soon discovers that Annie is unaware of Nervous' death, and she admits that he left her. Nevertheless, she chooses to keep the charm, hinting that Nervous never stopped loving her. Nervous' ghost will leave Espiritu Estate forever after the player complete this task and then talk to Emily.

Nervous looks quite different in this game, while his outfit is similar, his hair is a bright reddish-yellow and his facial features look more normal and are far less customized, possibly due to the limitations of the PSP hardware.  

Despite only being a ghost, the game files reveal that he still has certain interests assigned to him, those being Politics, and, in contrast to his PC version, Crime and Environment.

==Biography==
Nervous Subject resides in [[Strangetown]] as an adult, and lives with the [[Beaker family]]. He has a black mohawk hairstyle and wears a gray T-shirt with a skeleton with loose bones on it, blue-gray jeans and sandals. He is 27 days away from being an elder. He is voiced by Stephen Kearin.

At one point during his early childhood, Nervous was taken away from his mother, [[Olive Specter]], by the [[social worker]]. According to his memories, he later moved in with [[Loki Beaker|Loki]] and [[Circe Beaker]], Strangetown's "mad scientist" couple, during his childhood. Although normal game mechanics would only allow this to happen through the [[adoption]] system, Nervous and the Beakers have no relation to each other on their [[family tree]], nor do the Beakers have memories of adopting him. They also would have been too young to adopt Nervous since he is almost as old as them, unless Loki and Circe had access to the [[Elixir of Life]], which is a possibility considering their reputation as mad-scientists.

Interestingly, Nervous' family tree only shows Olive as his mother, in contrast to the family trees of other pre-made Sims that typically display both parents. When looking through Olive's memories, it is revealed that the only individual she has a memory of [[WooHoo]] with is the [[Grim Reaper]]. Because of this, it is largely assumed that the Grim Reaper is Nervous' father, and this theory was confirmed in later games. Nervous lacks most of his mother's genetics; on closer examination, it is clear he is simply a clone of the Grim Reaper. Additionally, although [[Ophelia Nigmos]] is Nervous' cousin, they do not know one another when Strangetown is first played and erroneously lack family ties once they meet.

Nervous' bio states that Nervous twitches and blinks frequently, probably as a side effect from the Beakers experiments. He has the [[Family (aspiration)|Family]] aspiration, and when the Beakers' lot is first played, he will often roll wants to flirt or hug even though he will not like doing these things. He may also want to get married, which may be due to his aspiration being very low. For the first 7 or 8 game hours, the game will continually push "Stuff Face" actions on him while he is home, regardless of how hungry he is. This is a result of a script used for tutorial purposes, so he will see cockroaches (which are scripted as well since the house is fairly clean) and go into aspiration failure, unless the player diverts him away from them in time.

He does not appear to be very popular: his only friend is [[Pascal Curious]], although his lifetime relationship with him is only moderate. If ''[[The Sims 2: Nightlife|Nightlife]]'' is installed, he and Pascal will have good chemistry, leading to many fans pairing them together romantically. He also has a reasonably good relationship with Circe, but doesn't like Loki very much. Nervous will often wander onto the Curious lot when Pascal is about to give birth to his [[Tycho Curious|baby alien]].

According to Olive's memories, she was an elder when she had Nervous, which would not have been possible in normal gameplay. Additionally, her memories reveal a discrepancy about the ages of several Strangetown Sims. To illustrate, [[Lyla Grunt]] died before Nervous was born. However, this would mean the [[Grunt family|Grunt]] brothers should be older than Nervous. Nervous and the Beakers' memories are also inconsistent with their ages as all three remember Nervous moving in as a [[child]] despite him only being a few days younger than the Beakers. Hidden Nervous, on the contrary, remembers joining them as an adult, which would be more in line with the information [[Annie Howell]] provides the player about Nervous' life before his death in ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)|The Sims 2]]'' for PSP.

All three [[Curious family|Curious brothers]] will falsely be flagged as family when opening Nervous' corresponding relationship data in [[Package editor|SimPE]], but they will not perceive each other as such in-game.

==Biography==
This version of '''Nervous Subject''' is hidden in the game files. He is also the Nervous who [[Olive Specter|Olive]] remembers giving birth to. He is unplayable. It is also unknown if the [[Grim Reaper]] is his father because Olive (and all of her family) has dark skin while Nervous' is light and the Grim Reaper has no genetics. He can be found using [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]] and he will have a second thumbnail in the [[Elder|Elder Stage]] hidden in his [[SimPE|character files]]. This Nervous appears in the storytelling images of the [[Beaker family]]. He also has [[memories]], which is unusual for a hidden Sim. Unlike his in-game counterpart, this Nervous remembers joining the Beaker family as an [[adult]].

Oddly he recognizes [[Willow Nigmos|Willow]] and [[Ophelia Nigmos]] as his aunt and cousin respectively and vice versa but does not 'know' them causing them to appear in the unrelated category in SimPE. The playable Nervous does not have relations to Willow and Ophelia.

The hidden Nervous starred in an old ''The Sims 2'' video Friday the 13th. Nervous is seen suffering throughout the day and ultimately died by satellite at the end of the video. In the said video, he has the [[teen]] male [[voice]] instead of the adult male voice.

Despite being a hidden Sim, Nervous also has [[memories]] that can be found in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]].

==Trivia==
*Prior to the release of ''The Sims 2'', his original name was '''Nervous Beaker''', it was changed at some point during development.{{fact}}
*When displaying Nervous' gender preference in ''The Sims 2'' using [[testing cheats]] or checking in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]], it can be seen that he has a slight distaste for women.
*In Grim's Ghastly Manor, a graveyard from ''The Sims 3'' Store designed to look like the home of the Grim Reaper, a [https://www.flickr.com/photos/94002117@N04/10348156426/ nursery] can be seen in the attic. This is possibly in reference to Nervous Subject as he is implied to be the Grim Reaper's son.
*His name in ''The Sims 4: Life & Death'', '''Nyon''', may be a play on "nigh on", meaning near in space, time, or relation. His full name would sound similar to "nigh on specter", aka ''nearly a specter'' or ''close to a specter''.
**This might be a reference to his fate in his PSP storyline.
*In ''The Sims 4: Life & Death'', Nyon has the '''Survived Seven Nights in a Haunted House'''{{vgversion|TS4:PS}} Milestone, though [[Haunted house residential|Haunted Houses]] are only available with ''[[The Sims 4: Paranormal Stuff|Paranormal Stuff]]''. Since the [[Crow's Crossing#Specter Family Manor|Specter Family Manor]] has the ''"On Hallowed Grounds"'' [[Lot traits and challenges|Lot trait]], it could mean that the house is meant to be a Haunted House.
* In the initial version of ''The Sims 4: Life & Death'', Nyon neither possessed the Grimborn trait nor did Grim appear on his family tree, though he was branded with the scythe-shaped birthmark. This was fixed with [[The Sims 4/Patch 173|Patch 173]], meaning he has the Grimborn trait in new saves.

Buzz Grunt.text:
{{Era|TS2|TS2PSP|TS4}} {{Infobox Sim2 |name = General Buzz Grunt |image = |-|Default = [[File:Buzz Grunt.png|250px]] |-|Refreshed = [[File:General Buzz Grunt In-game.png|250px]] |caption = The General likes to have his clocks set to military time. He used to enjoy barbershop quartet singing, but that is classified information. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 |age = Adult |career = Military |careerlevel = General |asp = Popularity |sign = Leo |hair = Brown |eye = Gray |skin = Light |body = Fit |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[General Chip Grunt]], [[Missy Grunt]]|Both Deceased}} |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Lyla Grunt]]|Ex-Wife}} [[File:Deceased.png|16px|Deceased]] |maritalstatus = Divorced |child = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Son|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Son|[[Buck Grunt]]|Son}} |play = Playable |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim2 |name = General Buzz Grunt |image = [[File:General Buzz Grunt - PSP.png|250px]] |caption = Runs Division 47 like a well-oiled machine. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 (PSP) |age = Adult |hair = Brown |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Fit |family = [[Grunt family]] |child = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt|Colonel Tank Grunt]]|Son|[[Ripp Grunt|Corporal Ripp Grunt]]|Son}} |play = NPC |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim4 |name = Buzz Grunt |image = [[File:Buzz Grunt (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |sex = Male |game = The Sims 4 |age = Adult |career = Military |careerlevel = Grand Marshal |asp = StrangerVille Mystery |trait1 = Neat |trait2 = Active |trait3 = Self-Assured |trait4 = Home Turf |trait5 = Over-Achiever |hair = Brown |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Fit |family = [[Grunt family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Lyla Grunt]]|Ex-Wife}} [[File:Deceased.png|16px|Deceased]] |maritalstatus = Divorced |child = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Son|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Son|[[Buck Grunt]]|Son}} |play = Gallery |hiddentrait1=Argumentative|hiddentrait2=Highflier}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Grunt, Buzz}} '''General Buzz Grunt''' is a pre-made playable [[Sim]] residing in [[Strangetown]], one of the [[neighborhood]]s shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. He lives with his three sons, [[Tank Grunt|Tank]], [[Ripp Grunt|Ripp]], and [[Buck Grunt|Buck]]. His ex-wife, [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]], was [[shock|electrocuted]] sometime after she left him and is [[death|deceased]]. His [[General Chip Grunt|father]] and [[General Rock Grunt|grandfather]] were also generals. ==Biography== ===Life leading up to The Sims 2=== General Buzz's house is described as a domesticated boot camp, whose house number is 51, which is most likely a reference to the highly secretive [[military]] base '[[wikipedia:Area 51|Area 51]]'. He also takes a military approach to raising his sons, while his ex-wife [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]] took the part of emotionally caring for them — she taught them almost all [[toddler skill]]s, with General Buzz having taught [[Tank Grunt|Tank]] only two of his [[toddler]] skills. When first played, he is 15 days away from being an [[elder]]. He is [[voice]]d by Stephen Kearin. General Buzz is an aggressive [[Sim]] who has many feuds with others in the [[Strangetown]] community: [[Olive Specter]] (Lyla [[death|died]] on [[13 Dead End Lane|her lot]]), the [[Curious family|Curious brothers]], and [[Loki Beaker]] (he won [[fighting|fights]] with them as a [[teen]]). His most recent feud is with [[Pollination Tech 9 Smith|Pollination Technician#9 Smith]], because he had lost a fight with him. Many fans interpret General Buzz as trying to get [[alien]]s to leave Strangetown. Ironically enough, he has a higher lifetime [[relationship]] with Pollination Technician#9 than with his own sons. Despite this, he still considers PT9 an enemy, and he wants to fight him upon loading the Grunt lot for the first time in-game. He has positive, but low, relationships with the Curious brothers and Loki Beaker. He only has a negative relationship with Olive (though, oddly, she usually wants to invite him over when the [[Specter family]] is first played. This might be because Lyla died on Olive's lot). When viewing one of the pictures in the [[Grunt family]] album, General Buzz's skin color matches the medium (S3) skin tone, instead of the light (S1) skin tone he sports in-game. There is an [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewVdU0sJfdI early Strangetown trailer] featuring the Grunts and the Smiths. Both General Buzz and PT9 have different facial features, and General Buzz has the voice provided by David Boat, rather than the one provided by Stephen Kearin that he has in-game. Strangely, General Buzz doesn't have the [[memories|memory]] of mastering the [[body]] [[skill]]. Because he has reached level 4 of the Military [[career]], General Buzz has a [[Career rewards#Military|Military career reward]] available for him to purchase, disregarding the fact that there is already one in the backyard. Likely due to the amount of changes made through the development of the game, his relationship data in [[Package editor|SimPE]] towards [[Pascal Curious|Pascal]] and [[Lazlo Curious]], as well as Pollination Tech#9 Smith and Olive Specter, contain hidden, nonsensical family flags. These flags will not show up in-game. If the ''[[The Sims 2: FreeTime|FreeTime]]'' is installed, General Buzz's pre-destined [[hobby]] will be [[sports]], because of his active and grouchy personality.{{Vgversion|TS2:FT}} Strangely, if General Buzz's appearance is [[Game guide:How to extract the appearance of in-game Sims#The Sims 2|extracted]] with SimPE to [[Body Shop]], he will be [[Fitness (attribute)|thin]] instead of fit. The reason for this is that he has the fitness texture for thin Sims instead of the one for fit Sims. This implies that he was originally thin, and his fitness level was subsequently modified with a program like SimPE. The only way for him to have the fitness texture for fit Sims without hacks is by having him overeat until he becomes thin, and then have him work out until he is fit again. This also happens with many other pre-made Sims in ''The Sims 2''. Prior to the release of ''The Sims 2'', his name was simply '''Buzz Grunt'''. This was changed at some point during development. His default thumbnail shows his polo shirt in low resolution; this can be fixed by changing his appearance in the mirror. ===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (PSP)=== In ''The Sims 2'' for PSP, General Buzz has escalated his war against the [[Smith family|Smiths]], kidnapping [[Jenny Smith|Jenny]], [[Jill Smith|Jill]], and [[Johnny Smith|Johnny]]. Despite the General's harsh nature, he does have a nice side. He will start to like the player once they build up their friendship. The General will still act nastily towards the player, but only to keep up appearances. He says he can't show favoritism, otherwise discipline will "go out the window." General Buzz's secrets in ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)]]'': *[[File:Personal.png|30x30px]] '''(Personal):''' They call him Buzz because he shaves his chest every morning. *[[File:Intimate.png|30x30px]] '''(Intimate):''' Buzz got his stripes by pushing paper above and beyond the call of duty. *[[File:Dark.png|30x30px]] '''(Dark):''' Buzz sleeps with a [[teddy bear]] in camouflage that he calls "the Brigadier". *[[File:Secret.png|30x30px]] '''(Keep Enemies Closer):''' General Grunt has imprisoned the Smith family under the guise of "protecting" them. {{Personality type|Earth}} According to the game's data, General Buzz is [[interest]]ed in Work, Sci-Fi, and Politics. ===Life leading up to The Sims 4=== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/8ezu8juxEemA3X5qYTkq6g recreation] of General Buzz and [[Grunt family|his family]] was uploaded to [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 28, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. In this [[alternate universe|timeline]], Buzz is a grand marshal instead of a general, he has brown eyes instead of gray, and he is missing the black lines underneath his eyes. He is friends with all three of his sons, but his ex-wife is only an acquaintance. Unlike the remakes of the [[Newbie family]] and the [[Pleasant family]] on the Gallery, Buzz has several [[skill]] points in a variety of different areas. He has the bonus traits Over-Achiever and Argumentative from ''[[The Sims 4: Parenthood|Parenthood]]''. He also has the Highflier reward trait, which is achieved by completing the Stuck in their Shadow [[Scenario (The Sims 4)|Scenario]], which was only added to the game after the gallery upload. '''Tank Grunt''' (later known as '''Colonel Tank Grunt'''{{Vgversion|TS2PSP}}) is a pre-made playable [[Sim]] residing in [[Strangetown]], one of the [[neighborhood]]s shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. He is the oldest son of [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]] and [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]]. He is the older brother of [[Ripp Grunt|Ripp]] and [[Buck Grunt|Buck]], but is distant from both of them. Tank is the only one of his siblings who seems to want to follow their father into the [[Military]] [[career]], and the only [[teen]] in [[Strangetown]] who doesn't have any mutual friends when the [[neighborhood]] is first played. Tank's name is a reference to his military background and heritage.

==Biography==
===Life leading up to The Sims 2===
Tank wants to follow in his father's footsteps and aspires to become a General like him. They have a good [[relationship]], but Tank wants to impress him by getting a job in the [[Military]] [[career]]. Tank is also part of the feud against the [[Smith family]]. He is enemies with [[Johnny Smith]] and wants to win a [[fighting|fight]] against him. If Johnny throws a [[party]] while still a teen, Tank will attempt to crash it.

When first played, he is 5 days away from becoming an [[adult]]. Tank is [[voice]]d by Jack Conte. When he becomes an adult, he will be voiced by David Boat.

He considers his father, [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]], a friend, though the friendship is not mutual. This sort of one-sided relationship would not be possible in normal gameplay and could only occur using developer software or [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]].

Surprisingly, Tank doesn't have any [[body]] [[skill]] points or indeed any skill points at the start of the game. He has exactly the same [[interest]]s as his father. According to his SimDNA in SimPE, he has recessive alleles for blond hair and gray eyes.

Strangely, when looking in his family album, Tank appeared to have lighter skin as a [[child]] in one of the photos, while his father, Buzz, had darker skin. Tank also had lighter skin in another photo as a teen. Even though his grandmother, [[Missy Grunt|Missy]], [[death|died]] when he was a [[baby]] or [[toddler]], Tank doesn't have a [[memories|memory]] of her passing.

Strangely, if Tank's appearance is [[Game guide:How to extract the appearance of in-game Sims#The Sims 2|extracted]] with SimPE to [[Body Shop]], he will be [[Fitness (attribute)|thin]] instead of fit. The reason for this is that he has the fitness texture for thin [[Sim]]s instead of the one for fit Sims. This will become more apparent when he grows into an adult.

This implies that he was originally thin, and his fitness level was subsequently modified with a program like SimPE. The only way for him to have the fitness texture for fit Sims without hacks is by having him overeat until he becomes thin, and then have him work out until he is fit again. This also happens with many other pre-made Sims in ''[[The Sims 2]]''.

His default thumbnail shows his polo shirt in low resolution; this can be fixed by changing his appearance in the mirror.

===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (PSP)===
Colonel Tank lives in the [[Division 47#Barracks|Barracks]] at the [[military]] base [[Division 47]] with [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]], [[Ripp Grunt|Corporal Ripp]], and the [[Smith family]]. His youngest brother, [[Buck Grunt|Buck]], doesn't appear in this game. Someone has hacked Tank's computer, and the player's [[Sim]] has to repair it. During this time, he will constantly [[Fight (social type)|attack]] Ripp until his computer is fixed. It is also possible to sell secrets to Tank, and he pays the highest for other NPCs in Division 47, science and sci-fi secrets. The one he wants to know for his mission is why [[Pollination Tech 9 Smith|Mister Smith]] is outside around midnight, snooping by the [[alien]] crash site. If the player chooses not to tell him, he will become very angry with the Sim.

Oddly, Tank's eye color in the PSP version is brown, but in the PC game, his eyes are blue. This is also the case with his brother, Ripp. Both of them are [[adult]]s in this game.

According to the game's data, Tank is [[interest]]ed in Politics, Sci-Fi, Environment, and, unlike his PC counterpart, Fashion.

Tank's secrets from ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)]]'': 
*[[File:Personal.png|30px]] '''(Personal):''' Tank wanted to go into ballet, but his father forced him into the military.
*[[File:Intimate.png|30px]] '''(Intimate):''' Tank secretly blames Ripp for stealing his first love... an action figure named Missy McBoom.
*[[File:Dark.png|30px]] '''(Dark):''' Tank once got punished by Buzz for being "too creative" with his face paint.
*[[File:Secret.png|30px]] '''(Tank's Incompetence):''' Tank let someone hack into his security computer.
{{Personality type|Fire}}

===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (Game Boy Advance)===
In ''[[The Sims 2 (GBA)|The Sims 2]]'' for GBA, Tank is a resident of [[Strangetown]] who is unaware that he is being filmed for a television show. He lives in the barracks, which are next to the Medical Center. He plays both major and minor roles in several episodes and is even seen in the introduction for each episode. Tank refers to himself as a "higher ranking officer," although his specific role within the army is never stated. He tends to be quite formal, calling the player "Citizen," and has the voice of a stereotypical army general. He will randomly start to pretend he is aiming a large gun (such as a sniper rifle) at times. 

[[Dusty Hogg]] introduces the player to Tank in the tutorial mission, where he says that Tank is the only guy in town with a worse temper than him. He insults the player, Dusty, and Dusty's gift for the player before admitting that he's not really such a grouch and instead is a gentle soul. He just fears drastic change. The player can talk to him in ''Buried By the Mob'', but he will just yell at the player for thinking he is dressed weirdly.

During the mission ''What Digs Beneath'', the player can ask Tank for help with removing an iron shelf from the chop shop after getting permission from [[Optimum Alfred]]. He believes it to be a "Top Secret Government Mission," but wonders why he hasn't been told, as he is a higher-ranking officer. He follows the player, but upon getting getting there, he believes that it is an "inappropriate seizure of private property" and refuses to help, saying, "As an officer and a gentleman, I cannot justify breaking the law... Goodbye miscreant. When they throw you in the dock for stealing, don't go calling for me," and leaves. The player can also talk to [[Auda Sherif]] to complete this goal, although Auda will also refuse upon getting to the chop shop. The player will have to talk to [[Jimmy "The" Neck]] instead.

In ''Aliens Arrived'', a strange-talking Tank comes up to the player and Dusty and asks them to give a bouquet of strange-looking paper flowers to [[Kayleigh Wintercrest]]. When the player does that, she will realize that the flowers are made of satellite images taken of the nuclear power plant. The player, Dusty, and Kayleigh will go to talk to Tank, only to realize that there were two Tanks! One of them is promptly revealed to be an alien in disguise, introducing the main issue in this episode. He also appears in the ending cutscene.

In ''The New Cola'', Tank walks in on Dusty and [[Ava Cadavra]] having a discussion on ladybugs to announce that he got a six-pack of New Cherry Guava King Chug Chug Cola. He will make the main character drink a can of it with him, and then, after realizing that the New Cherry Guava King Chug Chug Cola is making him feel weird, both the player and he will shrink down to a very small size. The rest of the episode features the player and Tank fighting through hordes of ladybugs. Midway through, Tank will get surrounded by the ladybugs and run off, and the player will have to find him and intimidate him in order to get him to move. It is implied that he is absolutely terrified of ladybugs and calls them "disgusting monsters."

During ''The Doomed Earth'', the player must coax a way to take Tank's telescope from him. At first, he will deny that he has one, implying that the player only thinks he has one due to being a military man. The player must talk to [[Misty Waters]], who will say that Tank uses his telescope to keep an eye on [[Ara Fusilli]], and that asking a man in town to flirt with her will likely make him come out. The player must ask [[Honest Jackson]], [[Luthor L. Bigbucks]], or [[Tristan Legend]] to do so, and once any of them does, Tank will come running out, talking about how Ara's father is paying him to keep an eye on her. Ara will try to bribe Tank to stop watching her. The player can then steal his telescope while he is distracted. 

In ''It All Came to an End'', the player can talk to Tank to be informed of the location of one of [[Optimum Alfred]]'s parts.

And finally, during ''A Very Special Reunion'', Tank is one of the characters that the player must find and bring back for the reunion. After talking to [[Frankie Fusilli]], the player will hear a pre-recorded tape from Tank, stating that after Strangetown was being taken over by aliens, he decided to go into hiding until they could retake the city from them. He asks for any humans to come and find him. He is located in the [[Yeti]]'s ice cave, and when the player talks to him, he is very aggressive and assumes that they are an alien. The player will have to intimidate him to calm him down, to which he will explain that [[Burple]] stole his house from him, and he will only join the reunion if the player can get his house back. Thankfully, this is quite easy to do, as paying Burple only 500 [[Simoleon]]s will do the trick.

Tank's secret in ''[[The Sims 2 (GBA)|The Sims 2]]'' for GBA is unlocked by reaching maximum intimidation with him.

===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (Nintendo DS)===
In ''[[The Sims 2 (Nintendo DS)|The Sims 2]]'' for Nintendo DS, Tank appears as a hotel guest. He has no story purpose, but he appears on the 10 [[simoleon]] lottery card, "The Emperor's Coffers." If in a room with a stereo, he will autonomously change the radio in the saloon to the track "Heavy Metal." If the player is male, they can unlock Tank's outfit after defeating 25 goons using the [[Ratticator]] and checking the Game Stats panel in the manager's suite (although it won't show up in the player's dresser until [[Jebediah S. Jerky]]'s outfit is unlocked as well, which is unlocked after defeating 25 aliens). 

Tank's [[Secrets (The Sims 2 Nintendo DS and GBA)|secret]] is that the camouflage pattern is actually tattooed on his face. Unlocking his secret will unlock [[Bigfoot (Nintendo DS)|Bigfoot]]'s concept art.

===Life leading up to The Sims 4===
An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/8ezu8juxEemA3X5qYTkq6g recreation] of Tank and his family was uploaded to the [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 28, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. In this [[alternate universe|timeline]], Tank is the same age as [[Ripp Grunt|Ripp]] (both will become [[young adult]]s in 12 days) and he is friends with everyone in his family. He has the same [[Aspiration (The Sims 4)|aspiration]] and [[Trait (The Sims 4)|traits]] as his father, except for the neat trait and [[General Buzz Grunt|Buzz]]'s traits from ''[[The Sims 4: Parenthood|Parenthood]]''. He also has the Physically Gifted reward trait from completing the Rambunctious Scamp childhood aspiration. Unlike his ''[[The Sims 2|Sims 2]]'' incarnation and the remakes of the [[Newbie family]] and the [[Pleasant family]] on the Gallery, Tank has several [[skill]] points in a variety of different areas. He also carries incomplete [[homework]] in his [[inventory]].

He is going to do whatever he wants to do, which is mostly what everyone else is doing. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 |age = Teen |career = Slacker |careerlevel = Gas Station Attendant |school = Public School |grade = C |asp = Romance |sign = Sagittarius |hair = Brown |eye = Dark Blue |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = [[General Buzz Grunt]], {{Relative|[[Lyla Grunt]]|Deceased}} |siblings = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Older Brother|[[Buck Grunt]]|Younger Brother}} |maritalstatus = Single |play = Playable |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Corporal Ripp Grunt |image = [[File:Ripp Grunt (PSP).png|250px]] |caption = Doesn't seem to fit into the military lifestyle. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 (PSP) |age = Adult |hair = Black |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = [[General Buzz Grunt]] |siblings = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt|Colonel Tank Grunt]]|Older Brother}} |maritalstatus = Single |play = NPC |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim4 |name = Ripp Grunt |image = [[File:Ripp Grunt (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |sex = Male |game = The Sims 4 |age = Teen |school = High School |grade = C |asp = Friend of the World |trait1 = Good |trait2 = Goofball |trait3 = Gregarious |hair = Brown |eye = Blue |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = [[General Buzz Grunt|Buzz Grunt]], {{Relative|[[Lyla Grunt]]|Deceased}} |siblings = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Older Brother|[[Buck Grunt]]|Younger Brother}} |maritalstatus = Single |play = Gallery }}{{DEFAULTSORT:Grunt, Ripp}} '''Ripp Grunt''' (later known as '''Corporal Ripp Grunt''') is a pre-made playable [[Sim]] residing in [[Strangetown]], one of the [[neighborhood]]s shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. He is the middle son of [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]] and the late [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]]. His older brother is [[Tank Grunt|Tank]], and his younger brother is [[Buck Grunt|Buck]]. ==Biography== ===Life leading up to The Sims 2=== Unlike [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]] and [[Tank Grunt|Tank]], Ripp does not have an [[interest]] in the [[military]]. Also, he is the only member of the household to have any playful points. Ripp does not get along well with his father and Tank and has a negative [[relationship]] with them both, but he is friends with [[Buck Grunt|Buck]]. He is friends with [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia Nigmos]] and has a high relationship with [[Johnny Smith]], though they are not friends yet. He is a [[Romance (aspiration)|Romance]] [[Sim]], but he doesn't have any romances when the family is first played. At the start of the game, Ripp is 8 days away from becoming an [[adult]]. His aspiration will be in mild red. He is [[voice]]d by Jack Conte. When he becomes an [[adult]], he will be voiced by David Boat. Like a few other pre-made Sims, Ripp has a mismatched [[personality]] and star sign. His personality matches that of a Libra, but his star sign is Sagittarius. Ripp has brown hair and dark blue eyes, but also carries recessive alleles for blonde hair and gray eyes. In his default thumbnail, his teeth are not properly shown; this can be fixed by changing his appearance in the mirror. If ''[[The Sims 2: FreeTime|FreeTime]]'' is installed, Ripp's predestined hobby will be [[arts and crafts]]. Ripp was also taught all his [[toddler skill]]s by [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]], but grew up badly. This may indicate that he had no particular [[Wants and fears|wants]] to learn them, which is unusual for a [[toddler]]. ===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (PSP)=== Ripp is featured in ''[[The Sims 2]]'' for [[The Sims 2 (PSP)|PSP]] as an [[adult]]. Evidently, his [[relationship]] with [[Tank Grunt|Tank]] has gotten worse since ''The Sims 2'', probably because of the large difference in rank with his older brother (He is a corporal while Tank is a colonel). When you first see him on the PSP, he is being constantly [[Fight (social type)|attacked]] by Tank, and talking to him will reveal he is beaten up regularly by him and has gotten "used" to it. He says he is a "useless, good-for-nothing" quartermaster, quoting his [[General Buzz Grunt|father]]. He seems a lot shyer compared to his PC counterpart, with his [[personality]] and mannerisms. Ripp is the shop vendor for [[Division 47]] and sells a variety of items, including gumflowers and bulbs. Strangely, while Ripp has brown hair and dark blue eyes in ''The Sims 2'', he has black hair and brown eyes in the PSP version. According to the game's data, Ripp's [[interest]]s include Food, and, unlike his PC counterpart, Politics and Sci-Fi. Ripp's secrets from ''[[The Sims 2 (PSP)]]'': *[[File:Personal.png|30x30px]] '''(Personal):''' Ripp always loves to look at the stars... until he walks into a lamppost. *[[File:Intimate.png|30x30px]] '''(Intimate):''' Ripp lost much of his body hair in an experimental blow-dryer incident. *[[File:Dark.png|30x30px]] '''(Dark):''' Ripp's debilitating [[Wants and fears|fear]] of [[toilet]]s was caused by one too many swirlies as a [[child]]. *[[File:Secret.png|30x30px]] '''(Innocent Victim):''' Ripp's brother beats him up regularly, even though they are both [[adult]]s. {{Personality type|Water}} ===Life leading up to The Sims 4=== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/8ezu8juxEemA3X5qYTkq6g recreation] of Ripp and his family was uploaded to [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 28, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. In this [[alternate universe|timeline]], Ripp is the same age as [[Tank Grunt|Tank]] (both will become [[young adult]]s in 12 days), and he is friends with everyone in his family. His [[Aspiration (The Sims 4)|aspiration]] is also inconsistent with ''[[The Sims 2]]''; he appears to be more [[interest]]ed in making friends than finding [[relationship|lovers]] and has the friend of the world aspiration. His voice is warm. Unlike the remakes of the [[Newbie family]] and the [[Pleasant family]] on the Gallery, Ripp has several [[skill]] points in a variety of different areas, such as [[Instrument skill#The Sims 4|guitar]] and [[vampire lore]].
