{{Era|TS2|TS4}} {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Buck Grunt |image = |-|Default = [[File:Buck Grunt.png|250px]] |-|Refreshed = [[File:Buck Grunt In-game.png|250px]] |caption = More than anything else, Buck wants to be a pet stylist to the stars. He spends a lot of time wondering why his father never seems to notice him. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 |age = Child |school = Public School |grade = A+ |asp = Grow Up |sign = Scorpio |hair = Blond |eye = Dark Blue |skin = Light |body = Fat |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[General Buzz Grunt]], [[Lyla Grunt]]|Deceased}} |siblings = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Older Brother|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Older Brother}} |play = Playable |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim4 |name = Buck Grunt |image = [[File:Buck Grunt (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |sex = Male |game = The Sims 4 |age = Child |school = Grade School |grade = A |asp = Whiz Kid |trait1 = Genius |hair = Blond |eye = Blue |skin = Light |body = Fat |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[General Buzz Grunt|Buzz Grunt]], [[Lyla Grunt]]|Deceased}} |siblings = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Older Brother|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Older Brother}} |play = Gallery }}{{DEFAULTSORT:Grunt, Buck}} '''Buck Grunt''' is a pre-made playable [[Sim]] residing in [[Strangetown]], one of the [[neighborhood]]s shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. He is the youngest son of [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]] and the late [[Lyla Grunt|Lyla]]. He has two older brothers, [[Ripp Grunt|Ripp]] and [[Tank Grunt|Tank]]. ==Biography== ===Life leading up to The Sims 2=== Studious and smart, Buck is serious but also nice, and has an A+ in [[school]] when the game begins. He is the nicest member of the [[51 Road to Nowhere|Grunt household]], with 9 nice points. He also has a good [[relationship]] with his acquaintance [[Jill Smith]], despite the feud between [[Grunt family|his family]] and [[Smith family|hers]]. Overall, Buck gets along with his family but is somewhat distant from [[Tank Grunt|Tank]] and [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]]. According to his [[biography|bio]], his accomplishments are largely ignored by his father. He is overweight when the family is first played, and is 4 days away from becoming a [[teen]]. He wants to be a pet stylist to the stars, although there is no such [[career]] or level in any job. When he becomes an [[adult]], he will be [[voice]]d by Stephen Kearin. While Buck has dark blue eyes, he carries the recessive allele for gray eyes. He has short blond hair. Buck wears a red T-shirt over a yellow long-sleeved shirt, with khaki green shorts and sandals. He has the same clothing and hair color as [[Strangetown]] [[townie]] [[Samuel Riley]]. Like Jill, Buck has a hidden [[Popularity]] [[Aspiration (The Sims 2)|aspiration]] token, which can be viewed in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]]. Other pre-made [[toddler]]s and [[child]]ren have this quirk, though these children's aspirations can be changed when they become teens. Strangely, if Buck's appearance is [[Game guide:How to extract the appearance of in-game Sims#The Sims 2|extracted]] with SimPE to [[Body Shop]], he will be [[Fitness (attribute)|thin]] instead of fat. This is also the case with [[Antonio Monty|Antonio]] and [[Claudio Monty]]. The reason for this is that he will have the fitness texture for thin [[Sim]]s when he becomes a teen instead of the one for fat Sims. This will become more apparent when he becomes an adult. This implies that he was originally thin, and his fitness level was subsequently modified with a program like SimPE. The only way for him to have the fitness texture for fat Sims without [[mod|hacks]] is by having him work out until he becomes thin, and then have him overeat until he is fat again. This also happens with many other pre-made Sims in ''[[The Sims 2]]''. The prima guide suggests that General Buzz should train him on the [[Career rewards#Military|obstacle course]], in which case Buck will be able to become thin. ===Life leading up to The Sims 2 (PSP)=== In ''[[The Sims 2]]'' for [[The Sims 2 (PSP)|PlayStation Portable]], his [[General Buzz Grunt|father]] and brothers make an appearance, yet Buck does not. The reason for this is unknown. ===Life leading up to The Sims 4=== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/8ezu8juxEemA3X5qYTkq6g recreation] of Buck and [[Grunt family|his family]] was uploaded to [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 28, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. Buck is friends with everyone in his family and is close to mastering the [[mental]] [[skill]]. He carries incomplete [[homework]] in his [[inventory]]. {{Era|TS2|TS4}} {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Lyla Grunt |image = [[File:Lyla Grunt.png|250px]] |sex = Female |game = The Sims 2 |age = Adult |asp = Romance |sign = Libra |state = Ghost |cod = Electrocution |hair = Blonde |eye = Dark Blue |skin = Tan |body = Thin |family = [[Grunt family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[A.P. Vandermorgan]], [[Jacqueline Vandermorgan]]|Both Deceased}} |spouse = {{Spouse|[[General Buzz Grunt]]|Ex-Husband}} |maritalstatus = Divorced |child = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Son|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Son|[[Buck Grunt]]|Son}} |play = Deceased |neighbor = Strangetown}} {{Infobox Sim4 |image = |-|Ghost= [[File:Lyla Grunt Ghost.png|250px]] |-|Alive= [[File:Lyla Grunt (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |game = The Sims 4 |sex = Female |age = Adult |state = Ghost |rank = Wispling |career = Unemployed |cod = Poison |trait1 = Good |trait2 = Geek |trait3 = Slob |trait4 = Alluring |asp = Soulmate |hair = Blonde |eye = Blue |skin = Tan |body = Thin |family = [[Grunt family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[General Buzz Grunt]]|Ex-Husband}} |maritalstatus = Divorced |child = {{Relative|[[Tank Grunt]]|Son|[[Ripp Grunt]]|Son|[[Buck Grunt]]|Son}} |play = Gallery }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Grunt, Lyla}} '''Lyla Grunt''' {{nee|Vandermorgan}} is a pre-made deceased Sim who resided in [[Strangetown]], one of the [[Neighborhood|neighborhoods]] shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. She is the daughter of [[A.P. Vandermorgan|A.P.]] and [[Jacqueline Vandermorgan]], the ex-wife of [[General Buzz Grunt|General Buzz]], and the mother of [[Tank Grunt|Tank]], [[Ripp Grunt|Ripp]], and [[Buck Grunt|Buck]]. Lyla has the [[Romance (aspiration)|Romance]] [[Aspiration (The Sims 2)|aspiration]], and her [[zodiac sign]] is [[Zodiac sign|Libra]]. Her main [[interest]]s include Paranormal, Money, and Weather. She also has a hidden [[Family (aspiration)|Family aspiration]] token. An image of Lyla in her [[elder]] stage can be found in her character file and can be seen using [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]]. Unlike most pre-made deceased Sims, Lyla was created at the same time as the rest of her family. ==Biography== ===Life leading up to The Sims 2=== Before Lyla died, she divorced from General Buzz and moved out. The reason they broke up is unknown, and Lyla's whereabouts after she moved out of the Grunt house are also not known. It appears that Lyla met [[Olive Specter]] at some point because Lyla mysteriously died in Olive's garden, where her [[gravestone|grave]] can be found. Her [[ghost]] is that of a [[Sim]] who died of [[shock|electrocution]]. Strangely, her family has no [[memories]] of her [[death]]. It is not clear if this is a developer oversight or if the family was intended to be unaware of her death. With ''[[The Sims 2: Nightlife|Nightlife]]'' or a later [[Content pack#Expansion pack|expansion]], the player is able to move her grave to a different lot, which will give her sons a memory of her death. Olive illogically has a memory of Lyla dying long before her own son, [[Nervous Subject]], was born, who is now an [[adult]]. This is inconsistent with the timeline of Lyla leaving her family after Buck became a [[child]]. Before Lyla died, she was 36 days from being an [[elder]], meaning that she may have used the [[Elixir of Life]] shortly after entering adulthood. According to [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]], Lyla had unlinked [[relationship|relations]] with [[Creon Nigmos|Creon]] and [[Willow Nigmos]], [[Earl E. DeMise|Earl E.]] and [[Tim Lee DeMise]], [[Hugh Thanasia|Hugh]] and [[Lou Thanasia]], [[Ichabod Specter]], [[Peponi Muenda|Peponi]] and [[Lerato Muenda]], as well as [[townie]] [[Bella Goth]]. When viewing Lyla's [[personality]] in SimPE, it can be seen that she has 6.9 playful points and 8.2 nice points, which wouldn't be possible in normal gameplay. ====Appearance==== Lyla's entire character file is in an outdated format; as a result, her face is corrupted, and her clothing in-game is randomized. Her corrupted appearance is [[genetics|genetic]]. If Lyla has more children after being resurrected, they will inherit her corrupted facial features. Changing her appearance in a mirror will make her appearance even more glitched.{{Fact}} Her appearance can be safely changed with [[Career rewards#Show business|Dr. Vu's Automated Cosmetic Surgeon]], assuming the appliance doesn't malfunction. As a [[ghost]], her corrupted face will be randomized, or she will "steal" the face of a nearby living [[Sim]]. Lyla's true appearance features tanned skin, blonde hair, and dark blue eyes, despite her original portrait displaying her with brown eyes. She also wears a very elegant pink dress in her thumbnail. However, as shown in the family album, her clothes and hairstyle when she moved out of the [[Grunt family|Grunt]] house are different - she wears a blue tank top and tan trousers. Her outfit data also contains another casual outfit: a red dress with boots and a long black coat. Meaning she may have been meant to stay alive, but the developers later decided otherwise. Lyla's ''original'' face for her [[elder]] [[life stage]] has a deformed low LOD face model, which is only visible on low-end settings. Though she is indeed very buggy, and her facial corruption can be passed along genetically, resurrecting Lyla will not cause corruption to the [[neighborhood]] nor to your game, and she can be resurrected just fine.https://www.reddit.com/r/sims2/comments/15d66qn/comment/ju2vwt9/?context=3 {{Resurrect-in-game|sims2}} {{Corrupted-face}} ===Life leading up to The Sims 4=== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/8ezu8juxEemA3X5qYTkq6g recreation] of Lyla and her family was uploaded to [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 28, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. In this [[alternate universe|timeline]], Lyla is a playable [[ghost]] who died because she was poisoned. She is friends with all three of her sons, but her ex-husband is only an acquaintance. Unlike the remakes of the [[Newbie family]] and the [[Pleasant family]] on the Gallery, Lyla has several [[skill]] points in a variety of different areas. Despite being a ghost, Lyla's simology panel indicates that she will become an [[elder]] in 23 days. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims 4= {{SkillTable3 |charisma = 4 |comedy = 3 |fitness = 4 |logic = 5 |painting = 4 |programming = 7 }} }} |-|Relationships= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims 4= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Buzz Grunt (The Sims 4).png|50px]] |name = [[General Buzz Grunt|Buzz Grunt]] |level = Acquaintance }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Tank Grunt (The Sims 4).png|50px]] |name = [[Tank Grunt]] |level = Friend }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Ripp Grunt (The Sims 4).png|50px]] |name = [[Ripp Grunt]] |level = Friend }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Buck Grunt (The Sims 4).png|50px]] |name = [[Buck Grunt]] |level = Friend }} }} }} |-|Personality= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims 2= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Libra |neat = 0 |outgoing = 6 |active = 4 |playful = 6 |nice = 8 }} }} |-|Interests= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims 2= {{InterestTable |environment = 0 |food = 6 |weather = 8 |culture = 2 |money = 9 |politics = 1 |paranormal = 9 |health = 3 |fashion = 4 |travel = 4 |crime = 1 |sports = 4 |entertainment = 1 |animals = 4 |work = 6 |school = 4 |toys = 4 |scifi = 0 }} }} ==Gallery== Lyla Grunt Intended face.png|Lyla's intended appearance in ''The Sims 2'', based on her Geometric Data Container information Lyla Grunt (Genetic).png|Lyla with her glitched appearance Lyla Grunt's Elder Appearance.png|Lyla's hidden thumbnail of her as an [[elder]]. {{Era|TS1|TSC|TS2|TS2C|TS2PETSC|TS3RV|TS4}} {{Missing-info|The Sims 4}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Newbie, Bob}} '''Robert "Bob" Newbie, Jr.''', is a [[Sim]] who makes his first appearance (along with his wife, [[Betty Newbie]]) in the player tutorial in ''[[The Sims]]''. After the completion of the tutorial, he can be played like any other Sim. [[Timeline of events in The Sims series|Due to the in-game chronology]] in ''The Sims'' series, he appears as a [[teen]] in ''[[The Sims 3]]'', living with his parents [[Robert Newbie|Robert]] and [[Mags Newbie|Mags]] in Riverview. Bob is not alive in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', though he is present in the [[family tree]] of the [[Broke family]]. Aside from main title releases, Bob appears in several console games. He and Betty are some of the most popular Sims of all time. Because of that, two families appear to be based on them; these are the [[Pancakes family]] and the [[Andrews family]]. __NOTOC__ {{Tabber |tab1 = The Sims 4 |text1= {{Infobox Sim4 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |caption = |sex = Male |game = The Sims 4 |age = Young Adult |asp = Friend of the Animals |trait1 = Slob |trait2 = Lazy |trait3 = Bookworm |trait4 = Animal Affection |hair = Brown |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Fat |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Betty Newbie]]|Wife}} |maritalstatus = Married |pets = [[Buddy Newbie]] |play = Gallery }} ==Biography== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/i7gNazFzEemOZHldy2Ruvw recreation] of Bob, Betty, and their dog [[Buddy Newbie|Buddy]] from the console version of ''[[The Sims 2 Pets (console)|The Sims 2: Pets]]'' was uploaded to the [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 15, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. Bob is unemployed, has no [[skill]]s, and is 22 days from becoming an [[adult]]. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTableSims4| {{RelationshipSims4 |image = Betty Newbie (The Sims 4).png |name = [[Betty Newbie]] |level = Sweethearts, Spouse }} {{RelationshipSims4 |image = Buddy Newbie Sims 4.png |name = [[Buddy Newbie]] |level = }} }} |tab2 = The Sims 3 |text2= {{Infobox Sim3 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 3).png|250px]] |caption = Bob Newbie loves to lie around and read. He's a good kid but he can't seem to clean up his room. He doesn't know what he wants to do with his life. |sex = Male |game = The Sims 3 Store |age = Teen |school = High School |grade = B |trait1 = Artistic |trait2 = Bookworm |trait3 = Good |trait4 = Slob |music = Latin |food = Fruit Parfait |color = Gray |hair = Light Brown |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |parents = [[Robert Newbie]], [[Mags Newbie]] |maritalstatus = Single |play = Playable |neighbor = Riverview}} ==Biography== Bob had a hard time adjusting to life in [[Riverview]] until he met his new best friend, [[Betty Newbie|Betty Simovitch]]. When he is not spending time with her, however, he mostly spends time lounging around indoors, leaving his parents concerned.{{confirm}} It is said that his father disapproves of his laziness, though Bob's relationship with his parents is great. He is a lot thinner in this game and has light brown hair and no facial hair. Bob's face is almost identical to his father, Robert's. However, some details have been customized. At the start of the game, Bob is 13 days from becoming a [[young adult]]. Even though the chronology of the series places Betty as his future wife, if left alone with story progression on, he may form [[relationship]]s with other women. However, he can easily be directed to start a [[Romantic (social type)|romance]] with Betty if the player desires, due to their high friendship level. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{SkillTable2 |painting = 1 }} |tab3 = The Sims 2 Pets (console) |text3= {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 2 Pets console).jpg|250px]] |caption = Bob Newbie was an odd child who insisted on speaking only in short, step-by-step sentences. But they are very different from the usual light-skinned Bob Newbie and Betty Newbie. Whether they are canonical in their appearance, as by the time of ''[[The Sims 2]]'', both Bob and Betty are deceased, or they are entirely different people, is unknown. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims 2 console).png|50px]] |name = [[Betty Newbie]] |level = 20, Acquaintance }} }} |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Gemini |neat = 4 |outgoing = 7 |active = 8 |playful = 3 |nice = 3 }} |tab5 = The Sims 2 |text5= {{Infobox Sim2 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 2).png|250px]] |sex = Male |game = The Sims 2 |age = Elder |asp = Romance |sign = Libra |state = Ghost |hair = Gray |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[Robert Newbie]], [[Mags Newbie]]|Both Deceased}} |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Betty Newbie]]|Wife}} [[File:Deceased.png|16px|Deceased]] |maritalstatus = Married |child = {{Relative|[[Brandi Broke]]|Daughter}} |play = Deceased |neighbor = Pleasantview}} ==Biography== By the time the storyline has caught up to ''[[The Sims 2]]'', he and his wife [[Betty Newbie|Betty]] are already deceased, though he left a daughter, [[Brandi Broke]] {{Nee|Newbie}}, to raise her family. She is the mother of two sons, [[Dustin Broke|Dustin]] and [[Beau Broke]], and is [[pregnancy|pregnant]] with her [[Unborn baby Broke|third son]] at the start of ''The Sims 2''. She is the widow of [[Skip Broke]]. Bob, his wife, his parents, and his in-laws can be resurrected with [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]]. He also has an unused beard and hairstyle that are very similar to the available ones. Storyline pictures show him with black hair, and SimPE shows he has [[genetics]] for black hair, which is different from ''[[The Sims]]'' and ''[[The Sims 3]]'' where his hair is brown and light brown, respectively. Interestingly, one of the storytelling images shows Bob giving Betty a massage, also clearly showing that he lost weight, as he is no longer fat. According to his age data in SimPE, Bob had 33 days left in the [[elder]] [[life stage]] when he died. He has a counterpart in the tutorial for ''[[The Sims 2]]'', called [[Bob Sim]]. Bob Sim resembles the Bob from other games, with red hair and a wife called Betty. However, there are several differences, and they don't appear to be the same Sim. The most obvious differences between the main game's Bob and the tutorial version are the different family trees and second names, as tutorial Bob's second name is Sim, while original Bob's is Newbie. Bob Sim is still an unplayable character in this version, appearing as a deceased ancestor, but has no connection to the [[Broke family]] and is not the father of Brandi Broke, but of the main tutorial sim, [[Tutorial Joe Sim]]. He is not canonically related to Bob Newbie in any way and doesn't appear in any other Sims game. {{ncd}} ==Simology== |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Libra |neat = 2 |outgoing = 8 |active = 2 |playful = 6 |nice = 7 }} |-|Interests= {{InterestTable |environment = 2 |food = 3 |weather = 7 |culture = 1 |money = 8 |politics = 3 |paranormal = 1 |health = 4 |fashion = 5 |travel = 5 |crime = 7 |sports = 7 |entertainment = 6 |animals = 4 |work = 0 |school = 4 |toys = 4 |scifi = 0 }} |tab6 = The Sims (Console) |text6= {{Infobox Sim1 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims console).jpg|250px]] |sex = Male |game = The Sims (console) |age = Adult |sign = Gemini |hair = Brown |skin = Light |body = |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Betty Newbie]]|Wife}} |maritalstatus = Married |play = Playable |neighbor = Willville}} ==Biography== Bob Newbie appears in ''[[The Sims (console)|The Sims]]'' for console, wearing the same clothes as in ''[[The Sims]]''. He and his wife [[Betty Newbie]] live in 7 [[Sim Avenue]]. They both share a 20+ relationship, so it is unknown if they are really [[marriage|married]]. Neither one has a [[career|job]], but it may be best to get them into the [[Military]] Career Track, since they are both very active. He likes to read books and water the plants, but doesn't like noise - he always turns down the TV and Stereo. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Betty Newbie icon.png]] |name = [[Betty Newbie]] |level = 20/20, Acquaintance }} }} |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Gemini |neat = 4 |outgoing = 7 |active = 8 |playful = 3 |nice = 3 }} |tab7 = The Sims |text7= {{Infobox Sim1 |name = Bob Newbie |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims).jpg]] |caption = Bob is new to the neighborhood. Can you help him get through this tutorial? |sex = Male |game = The Sims |age = Adult |career = Unemployed |sign = Aquarius |hair = Brown |skin = Light |body = Fat |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Betty Newbie]]|Wife}} |maritalstatus = Married |play = Playable |neighbor = Neighborhood 1}} ==Biography== Bob is one of the pre-made [[Sim]]s in ''The Sims'', and was one of the tutorial characters. He and his wife [[Betty Newbie|Betty]] had just moved into the neighborhood at the start of the game. They are inhabitants of [[Neighborhood 1]] and live at [[7 Sim Lane]]. They often make up the [[welcome wagon]]. Bob is bald, but has a mustache and a full beard. He is pudgy and starts out wearing dingy, greasy clothing.This is easily changed with a dresser, but may require the use of custom [[skin]]s, as [[Maxis]] did not provide a very good selection for fat [[Sim]]s. Bob likes to spend time reading. Although he is [[marriage|married]] to her, his [[relationship]] with Betty is only at the friendship level. A different version of Bob appeared in Japanese copies of the game, with a fit physique, tan skin, black hair, and a goatee (almost identical in appearance to [[MAHUIZOH "Jimmy" Maximus]], differing only by his mint green shirt and blue pants). According to [[Tools|SimEnhancer]], Bob was the first Sim created in Neighborhood 1. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{SkillTable |cooking = 3 |mechanical = 2 }} In Asian locales of the game, Bob Newbie does not have any [[skill]]s. |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Betty Newbie thumb.png]] |name = [[Betty Newbie]] |level = 55/55, Friend }} }} |-|Personality= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Aquarius |neat = 3 |outgoing = 6 |active = 4 |playful = 6 |nice = 6 }} {{!}}-{{!}} The Sims (Asia only)= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Aquarius |neat = 4 |outgoing = 4 |active = 4 |playful = 7 |nice = 6 }} }} |tab8 = In other games |text8= Bob Newbie is also an available character on ''[[w:c:simcity:SimCity 4|SimCity 4]]''. Betty Newbie.title: Betty Newbie
Betty Newbie.text:
{{Era|TS|TSC|TS2|TS2C|TS2PETSC|TS3RV|TS4|FA}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Newbie, Betty}} '''Betty Newbie''' {{nee|Simovitch}} is a [[Sim]] first introduced during the player tutorial in ''[[The Sims]]''. After the completion of the tutorial, she (along with [[Bob Newbie]]) can be played like other Sims. Due to the [[Timeline of events in The Sims series|chronology of events in ''The Sims'' series]], she appears as a teen under her maiden name in ''[[The Sims 3]]'', residing in [[Riverview]]. Aside from these major titles, Betty appears in several console titles, and appears (as a deceased Sim) in the [[family tree]] of several Sims in ''[[The Sims 2]]''. __NOTOC__ {{Tabber |tab1 = The Sims 4 |text1= {{Infobox Sim4 |name = Betty Newbie |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims 4).png|250px]] |caption = |game = The Sims 4 |sex = Female |age = Young Adult |trait1 = Creative |trait2 = Unflirty |trait3 = Active |trait4 = Muser |asp = Musical Genius |hair = Brown |eye = Dark Blue |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Bob Newbie]]|Husband}} |maritalstatus = Married |pets = [[Buddy Newbie]] |play = Gallery }} ==Biography== An official [[Maxis]] [https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/i7gNazFzEemOZHldy2Ruvw recreation] of Betty, Bob, and their dog [[Buddy Newbie|Buddy]] from the console version of ''The Sims 2: Pets'' was uploaded to the [[Gallery|''The Sims 4'' Gallery]] on February 15, 2019, marking the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''. Betty is unemployed, has no skills, and is 23 days from becoming an adult. If the player does not have ''[[The Sims 4: City Living]]'', her unflirty trait is replaced with [[loner]]. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTableSims4| {{RelationshipSims4 |image = Bob Newbie (The Sims 4).png |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = Sweethearts, Spouse }} {{RelationshipSims4 |image = Buddy Newbie Sims 4.png |name = [[Buddy Newbie]] |level = }} }} |tab2 = The Sims 3 |text2= {{Infobox Sim3 |name = Betty Simovitch |image = [[File:Betty Simovitch.png|250px]] |caption = Betty Simovitch knows her mother sees her as a second chance to reach the stardom she left behind. She's into music, but she's just not sure she wants to make it into a career in the same way her mother dreams about. |game = The Sims 3 Store |sex = Female |age = Teen |school = High School |grade = B |trait1 = Artistic |trait2 = Good |trait3 = Unflirty |trait4 = Virtuoso |music = Classical |food = Cookies |color = Pink |hair = Brown |eye = Green |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Simovitch family]] |parents = [[Vadim Simovitch]], [[Fatima Simovitch]] |maritalstatus = Single |play = Playable |neighbor = Riverview }} ==Biography== Betty is featured as a [[teen]], 13 days away from becoming a [[young adult]]. She lives in [[Riverview]] with her parents, [[Fatima Simovitch|Fatima]] and [[Vadim Simovitch|Vadim]]. Her mother dreams of Betty becoming a musician and hopes she will follow that path. Betty enjoys music but doesn't know if she wants to make it into a career like her mother envisions. When the game starts, she is best friends with [[Bob Newbie]]. Even though the chronology of the series places Bob as her future husband, if left alone with the story progression on, she may form relationships with other men. However, she can easily be directed to start a romance with Bob if the player desires, due to their high friendship level. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{SkillTable2 |charisma = 1 |guitar = 6 }} |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Vadim Simovitch.png|50px]] |name = [[Vadim Simovitch]] |level = Father, Good Friend }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Fatima Simovitch (The Sims 3).png|50px]] |name = [[Fatima Simovitch]] |level = Mother, Good Friend }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 3).png|50px]] |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = Best Friend }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Dallas Shallow.png|50px]] |name = [[Dallas Shallow]] |level = Friend }} }} |tab3 = The Sims 2 Pets (console) |text3= {{Infobox Sim2 |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims 2 Pets console).jpg|250px]] |caption = Betty Newbie launched her international career in helpology after publishing the popular self-help book, "Unleash the Gender Neutral Metaphor Within", but she recently moved to town to help people on a smaller scale. She certainly doesn't miss the hustle bustle of the big city. Rather she finds the pace of this town perfect for her brand of instructional tutelage. |game = The Sims 2 Pets (console) |sex = Female |age = Adult |career = Unemployed |asp = Family |sign = Leo |hair = Brown |eye = Brown |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |roommate = [[Bob Newbie]] |maritalstatus = Single |pets = [[Buddy Newbie]] |play = Playable |neighbor = Whiskerton }} ==Biography== Betty Newbie appears in ''[[The Sims 2 Pets (console)|The Sims 2 Pets]]'' for console. She lives with her roommate, [[Bob Newbie|Bob]] and dog, [[Buddy Newbie|Buddy]]. ==Simology== |-|Skills= {{SkillTable |cooking = 3 }} |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 2 Pets console).jpg|50px]] |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = 20, Acquaintance }} {{Relationship |image = [[File:Buddy Newbie.png|50px]] |name = [[Buddy Newbie]] |level = 60, Friend }} }} |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Leo |neat = 5 |outgoing = 10 |active = 2 |playful = 3 |nice = 5 }} |tab4 = The Sims 2 (console) |text4= {{Infobox Sim2 |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims 2 console).png|250px]] |game = The Sims 2 (console) |sex = Female |age = Adult |career = Unemployed |asp = Romance |sign = Capricorn |hair = Brown |eye = Gray |skin = Medium |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |roommates = [[Bob Newbie]] |maritalstatus = Single |play = Playable |neighbor = Pleasantview, Strangetown, and Melbourne }} ==Biography== Betty lives here with her roommate, Bob. However, they are very different from the usual light-skinned Bob Newbie and Betty Newbie. Whether they are canonical in their appearance, as both Bob and Betty are deceased by the time of ''[[The Sims 2]]'', or are entirely different people, is unknown. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Bob Newbie (The Sims 2 console).png|50px]] |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = 20, Acquaintance }} }} |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Capricorn |neat = 7 |outgoing = 4 |active = 1 |playful = 8 |nice = 5 }} |tab5 = The Sims 2 |text5= {{Infobox Sim2 |image = [[File:Betty Newbie.png|250px]] |game = The Sims 2 |sex = Female |age = Elder |asp = Fortune |sign = Scorpio |state = Ghost |hair = Gray |eye = Gray |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |parents = {{Relative|[[Vadim Simovitch]], [[Fatima Simovitch]]|Both Deceased}} |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Bob Newbie]]|Husband}} [[File:Deceased.png|16px|Deceased]] |maritalstatus = Married |child = {{Relative|[[Brandi Broke]]|Daughter}} |play = Deceased |neighbor = Pleasantview }} ==Biography== By the time the storyline has caught up to ''[[The Sims 2]]'', Betty and her husband Bob are already deceased. Through her daughter, [[Brandi Broke|Brandi]], Betty has two grandsons; [[Dustin Broke|Dustin]] and [[Beau Broke|Beau]], with a [[Unborn baby Broke|third]] on the way. Brandi was widowed by her husband, [[Skip Broke|Skip]], before the storyline of ''The Sims 2'' began. She has similar clothes and a hairstyle to [[Coral Oldie]]. Betty died shortly before the birth of her first grandson. Her husband died earlier; both died while Brandi was pregnant. When her character file is viewed in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]], her hair [[Genetics|genes]] are for black hair, which is rather strange since she has brown hair in all of her other appearances. This could imply her hair was dyed brown in ''The Sims 3'', or it could be a simple continuity error. By looking at the family pictures, it can be seen that Betty had lost weight. According to her age data in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]], Betty had 15 days left in the elder life stage when she died. {{ncd}} ==Simology== |-|Personality= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Scorpio |neat = 6 |outgoing = 5 |active = 8 |playful = 3 |nice = 3 }} |-|Interests= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims 2= {{InterestTable |environment = 8 |food = 1 |weather = 9 |culture = 3 |money = 8 |politics = 0 |paranormal = 4 |health = 2 |fashion = 8 |travel = 5 |crime = 3 |sports = 7 |entertainment = 3 |animals = 4 |work = 9 |school = 4 |toys = 4 |scifi = 0 }} }} |tab6 = The Sims (Console) |text6= {{Infobox Sim1 |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims console).jpg|250px]] |caption = Tomboy. Tease. Triathlete. Betty takes life by the neck, chokes it, and leaves it gasping for air. Mess with her and she'll mess you up right back, but get on her good side, and she'll be your friend for life. If you're looking for romance, make sure your Body skill is top-notch. Slackers need not apply. |game = The Sims (console) |sex = Female |age = Adult |sign = Pisces |hair = Brown |skin = Light |body = Thin |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Bob Newbie]]|Husband}} |maritalstatus = Married |household = [[Roomies household (console)|Roomies household]] |roommates = [[Bingo Roomies]], [[Carlos Roomies]], [[Layla Roomies]], [[Leon Roomies]], [[Zara Roomies]] |play = Playable |neighbor = Willville }} ==Biography== In ''[[The Sims (console)|The Sims]]'' for console, there are two separate instances of Betty between the different modes. In the Free-play Mode, Betty Newbie lives with [[Bob Newbie]] in 7 [[Sim Avenue]] wearing a blue cap, blue glasses, blue top, blue pants, and red shoes. They both share a 20+ relationship, so it is unknown if they are really married. Neither one has a job, but it may be best to put them in the [[Military]] [[career track]], since they are both very active, her zodiac sign is Pisces in this mode. She likes to read, play in the fountain, watch TV, and look at flamingos. Meanwhile, in the [[Get a Life Storyline]], she appears as Betty Roomies, being one of the [[Sim]]s the player can move in with after level 3, with interests in Travel and Music. Her zodiac sign is Cancer in this mode. She can also be seen at the ending movie, wanting to give the player a high-five. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Bob Newbie icon.png]] |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = 20/20, Acquaintance }} }} |-|Personality= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims (console) (Play The Sims)= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Pisces |neat = 5 |outgoing = 3 |active = 7 |playful = 3 |nice = 7 }} {{!}}-{{!}} The Sims (console) (Get a Life)= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Cancer |neat = 6 |outgoing = 3 |active = 6 |playful = 4 |nice = 6 }} }} |tab7 = The Sims |text7= {{Infobox Sim1 |image = [[File:Betty Newbie (The Sims).jpg]] |caption = Betty is new to the neighborhood. She is just getting familiar with her new environment. Can you help her learn to interact with her new home? |game = The Sims |sex = Female |age = Adult |career = Unemployed |sign = Aries |hair = Brown |skin = Light |body = Fat |family = [[Newbie family]] |spouse = {{Spouse|[[Bob Newbie]]|Husband}} |maritalstatus = Married |play = Playable |neighbor = Neighborhood 1 }} ==Biography== Betty appears a bit later when playing the [[Newbie family]] tutorial. She is considered the helpful housewife from 1950s suburbia. The Newbie home ([[7 Sim Lane]]) also has a 1950s suburbia theme, making it a custom-rendered tutorial. She is not in love with Bob, but players who play the Newbie family beyond the tutorial can handle their relationship as they please (although every adult Sim couple is considered spouses in ''[[The Sims]]''). A different version of Betty appeared in the Japanese version of the game, with a fit physique, a white dress, black hair, and completely different facial features. According to [[Tool|SimEnhancer]], Betty was the second Sim created in Neighborhood 1. ==Simology== |-|Relationships= {{RelationshipTable| {{Relationship |image = [[File:Bob Newbie thumbnail.jpg]] |name = [[Bob Newbie]] |level = 55/55, Friend }} }} |-|Personality= {{#tag:tabber|The Sims= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Aries |neat = 6 |outgoing = 7 |active = 4 |playful = 3 |nice = 5 }} {{!}}-{{!}} The Sims (Asia only)= {{PersonalityTable |sign = Aries |neat = 5 |outgoing = 8 |active = 6 |playful = 3 |nice = 3 }} }} }} ==Trivia== *Betty, along with [[Mortimer Goth]], [[Bella Goth]], Bob Newbie, [[Daniel Pleasant]], [[Grim Reaper|The Grim Reaper]], and [[Agnes Crumplebottom]] are the only pre-made Sims to appear in all four of the main series games. *Betty looks very similar to [[Janitor Tanya]] from ''[[The Sims: Vacation]]'' and [[Tidy Heidi]] from ''[[The Sims: Unleashed]]'', although Betty has brown hair while Tanya and Heidi have black hair. *Betty's body and clothing in ''The Sims'' are very similar to those of Peggy Bundy from the TV series ''Married With Children''. *Simmers have noted similarities between Betty and [[Eliza Pancakes]]. Firstly, both are named from diminutives of the given name Elizabeth, and both are married to men named Bob. Furthermore, Eliza's hairstyle is very similar to Betty's in ''[[The Sims 3]].'' He returned in ''[[The Sims 4: Cats & Dogs]]'' on February 15, 2019, to mark the 19th anniversary of ''[[The Sims]]''.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/i7gNazFzEemOZHldy2Ruvw The Newbie Family by Maxis]</ref> While Bob and Betty appear in ''[[The Sims 4]]'' base game, Buddy will only come with the family if ''Cats and Dogs'' is installed. He doesn't know any commands when his household is first played.

'''Miss Hell''' (born '''Marybell Smith''') is a pre-made [[vampire]] from the [[The Sims 4 Gallery|Gallery]],<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/z6qSYeJiEeaCcMwfVwF2tQ Rebellious Vampires by Maxis]</ref> who has been used in a teaser for ''[[The Sims 4: Vampires]]'', where she is turned into a vampire by [[Vladislaus Straud]] and then turns [[Caleb Vatore]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2oe6z6ShQwE Miss Hell in a teaser]</ref>

According to the description of a [[mirror]] in ''[[The Sims 4: Werewolves]]'', Miss Hell was born a [[Sim]] named Marybell Smith, who was extremely proud of her straight teeth. When she was turned into a vampire, she was so upset at not being able to see her teeth that she smashed her mirror and took the name Miss Hell.

Miss Hell's household on the Gallery, as well as the two other households of Vampires uploaded around the same time by Maxis, seem to imply the existence of three rival Vampire groups with different values and missions. Their household renders seem to support this theory. The '''Rebellious Vampires''', of which Miss Hell is a part, seem to focus on leading a rebellious, dastardly lifestyle (which probably includes drinking plasma from Sims rather than from plasma packs). This is further supported by the render where they seem akin to a gang of criminals with a punk, alternative fashion style, as well as Miss Hell's name, which includes the word 'Hell'. 

== Trivia ==

* Despite being uploaded to the Gallery, players cannot reupload her without having to alter her last name due to the Gallery's word filters.

'''Samantha Gratz''' is a pre-made [[Sim]] who made her first appearance in ''[[The Sims 4: Vampires]]''. She appears in several trailers, renders, and promotional screenshots for the game pack and can be found in the [[Gallery]], where she was uploaded by Maxis.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/0p5hPOJiEeaCdswfVwF2tQ Virtuous Vampires by Maxis]</ref>

Samantha's household on the Gallery, as well as the two other households of Vampires uploaded around the same time by Maxis, seem to imply the existence of three rival Vampire groups with different values and missions. Their household renders seem to support this theory. The '''Virtuous Vampires''', of which Samantha is a part, seem to focus on knowledge, creativity, and being Good Vampires (who do not drink plasma from Human Sims and instead use plasma packs). Conversely, Samantha has the Public Enemy aspiration, which focuses on being mean and mischievous to others.

'''Jordan Mayer''' is a pre-made [[Sim]] who is prominently featured in multiple trailers and other promotional material for ''[[The Sims 4: City Living]]''. Together with [[Penny Pizzazz]] and [[Danny Shino-Miller]], she appears on the front cover art.

In the trailers, Jordan can be seen arriving in [[San Myshuno]], hunting for an apartment, and finding work in the new [[critic]] career. She and her roommate, [[Jared Q]], can be downloaded from the [[The Sims 4 Gallery|Gallery]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/9Baw16BZEeaCwqaLBbYtLw Jordan and Jared by Maxis]</ref> The household description reads "Will these two become friends, or foes, or something else?" hinting at a romantic relationship that develops between them.

Jordan's apartment can also be found in the Gallery, where it was uploaded by Maxis.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/z6SMyqEpEeaOgKaLBbYtLw Jordan's Apartment by Maxis]</ref> It is supposed to be placed at 920 Medina Studios in the [[Arts Quarter]].

Jordan briefly appears in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtPy-71fkSc Discover University official reveal trailer] as a student at [[Foxbury Institute]].

==San Myshuno Reviews==
[[File:AshyJ.png|left]]Jordan has reviewed several locations and attractions on the interactive [[San Myshuno]] map under the name "AshyJ". <ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/pc/city-living-san-myshuno-map San Myshuno Map]</ref>
*[[Uptown#Skye Fitness|Skye Fitness]]: ''SO like, I never went into this place? But one time my friend did and she totes loved it <3 XOXO''
*[[Uptown#Stargazer Lounge|Stargazer Lounge]]: ''OMG! The drinks are TOTES FAB at the Stargazer. But, oof! Those big city prices.''
*[[Uptown#Landgraab Apartments|Landgraab Apartments]]: ''Omg! It. Would. Totes. RULE. To live here. One day! One day I tell you.''
*[[Uptown#Alto Apartments|Alto Apartments]]: ''Wow wow wow! I want to live HERE too! Omg. I need to really roll up my sleeves to make it here. Like, really make it!''
*[[Festivals#Spice Festival|Spice Festival]]: ''When I'm hankering to learn a new recipe to prep for my roommates, I head to the local food festival to sample the eats. I always learn new recipes!''
*[[Festivals#Flea Market|Flea Market Festival]]: ''There's nothing cooler than retro stuff! And new stuff! And... stuff! I love this place lol. Every time I visit there's new stuff to get, especially for a bargain hunter like me.''
*[[Spice Market#Culpepper House|Culpepper Apartments]]: ''Oh man! I want to move to the city so badly. Culpepper House seems...doable. It seems fine. I'll be fine!''
*[[Spice Market#Waterside Warble|Waterside Warble]]: ''I love karaoke and found the other bars a bit posh and high end. The Waterside Warble karaoke bar felt more welcoming!''
*[[Fashion District|Fashion District Food Carts]]: ''Not sure I could handle the tab for this every day, but wowee! Can't wait to come back here for a special treat.''
*[[Festivals#Food stand|Fashion District Food Carts]]: ''Soooo, I'm not sure the burgers are for me. When I think of big city, I think of exquisite, like, exciting things?''
*[[Festivals#Geekcon|GeekCon]]: ''Haha so one time I went here and entered into a video game competition and everyone was like "haha yeah right" but then I won! #geekcon #festivals #ftw''
*[[Festivals#Romance Festival|Romance Festival]]: ''I just know I'm going to meet my boo at the Romance Festival! It'll be JUST like the movies! My perfect city story!!!''
*[[Fashion District#Torendi Tower Penthouse|Torendi Tower]]: ''I got lost when I first moved to the city and asked the resident of Torendi Tower to use the bathroom and…wow it was weird!''
*[[Fashion District#Planet Honey Pop.21|Planet Honey Pop!]]: ''Absoluuuutely loooove this place. The drinks are lovely and the people, divine. I just wish my roommate wasn't so tone deaf - it's dreadful when he is up on stage.''
*[[Arts Quarter#Casbah Gallery|Casbah Gallery]]: ''WOW! I feel so sophisticated after visiting this place! I've never seen any art as beautiful as this before.''
*[[Arts Quarter|Outdoor Plaza]]: ''Like, I just LOVE art, and this place has soooo much of it! I just, like, take pictures of EVERYTHING. OMG.''
*[[Arts Quarter#FountainView Penthouse|FountainView Penthouse]]: ''Wow wow wow! How do people afford this place on new hire salaries! It'll be a while but this would be a lovely place to live!''
*[[Myshuno Meadows]]: ''OMG. Swans! There are swans in the lake. So cool. So romantic.''

He is frequently seen with a [[Pumpkin|jack-o'-lantern]] on his head in promotional images.

He shares his last name with the [[Julius Caesar|Caesar family]] of Veronaville, but any relation is unknown.

*Scrubs' name is a reference to '''two''' medical dramas: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scrubs_(TV_series) Scrubs] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grey%27s_Anatomy Grey's Anatomy]:
**His first name, Scrubs, refers to the title of the medical drama Scrubs.
**His surname "De Reve" sounds like "De Rêve", which is French for "Of [My] Dreams". This is a reference to the Grey's Anatomy character Derek Shepherd, nicknamed 'McDreamy' ('Mc' is a Scottish prefix indicating 'son of', which connects to the prefix 'De' in Scrubs' surname).
*Scrubs' last name goes back and forth between being spelled "DeReve" and "De Reve".

'''Aileen Rauvu''' is a pre-made [[alien]] who made her first appearance in ''[[The Sims 4: Get to Work]]''. She appears in several trailers and other merchandise for the game and can be found in the [[Gallery]], where she and her roommates were uploaded by Maxis.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/%2F67rs9zqEeSEGVXktHI0CQ Sul Sul by Maxis]</ref>

Aileen appears in two trailers for ''Get to Work''. In the Sul Sul trailer<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vLjas1jWi_w The Sims 4: Get to Work - Sul Sul trailer]</ref>, she terrorizes the crew of scientists who appear in her household. In the launch trailer, she falls in love with [[Ned Whalen]], whom she pollinates as seen in an official render. She has no set human disguise, and it will always be randomized upon loading her in Create-a-Sim.

==Trivia ==
*Her first name is a pun of the word "alien".
*She is the second pre-made alien in ''The Sims'' franchise not to have green skin (the first being [[Elza Moduguglod]]), but the first to have purple skin.

*Scrubs' name is a reference to '''two''' medical dramas: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scrubs_(TV_series) Scrubs] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grey%27s_Anatomy Grey's Anatomy]:
**His first name, Scrubs, refers to the title of the medical drama Scrubs.
**His surname "De Reve" sounds like "De Rêve", which is French for "Of [My] Dreams". This is a reference to the Grey's Anatomy character Derek Shepherd, nicknamed 'McDreamy' ('Mc' is a Scottish prefix indicating 'son of', which connects to the prefix 'De' in Scrubs' surname).
*Scrubs' last name goes back and forth between being spelled "DeReve" and "De Reve".

The '''Aspir family''' is a pre-made playable family residing in [[Desiderata Valley]], the [[neighborhood]] shipped with [[The Sims 2: FreeTime|''The Sims 2: FreeTime'']]. It consists of a married couple, [[Victor Aspir|Victor]] and [[Elizabeth Aspir|Elizabeth]], their daughter, [[Pauline Aspir|Pauline]], and Victor's father, [[Luis Aspir|Luis]]. There is a [[genie's lamp]] in the attic.

{{FamilyPage
|etymology = '''Aspir''': "to seek to reach," "aspiration," "earnest desire for something above one".
* '''Luis''': a Germanic name, meaning "forth," "to offer," "wreath," "garland," "man". Many Kings of France used it, a total of sixteen.
* '''Victor''': "to conquer," "brave," "energetic".
* '''Elizabeth''': "God is my oath".
* '''Pauline''': "generous actions," "benevolent feeling", "small", "tiny".
* '''Noriko''': From Japanese ''nori'' ("law, rule" or "code, ceremony") combined with ''ko'' ("child").
* '''Larisa''': a Russian name, whose diminutive is Lara. It also refers to a Greek city, Larisa. If divided, it may be the Spanish for "La Risa", which means "The Laughter".
* '''Raul''': a French name, meaning "brave counsellor".
* '''Paulina''': the same as Pauline.
* '''Manuel''': a very common name in Spain and Latin America. It means "God is with us" in Hebrew.

'''Kozlov''':
* '''Pavel''': comes from the Latin "Paulus", meaning "small", "tiny", "humble".
* '''Keesa''': probably a short form of Karelisa, a name referring to the region of Kareliya, which belongs to Russia.

'''Kimura''': Means "tree village" in Japanese, ki is tree, and mura is village.
* '''Jiro''': Means "second son" in Japanese, ro is son, and ni is two, but it turns into ji.
* '''Kumiko''': Means "Long Time Beautiful Child" in Japanese. Ku, for a long time, mi means beautiful, and ko is obviously child.

'''Una''': in Spanish and Italian, it's the female form of uno, one. It may also sound like a Russian word.
* '''Yuri''': interestingly, this Russian name is masculine even though it's given to a female relative. The first man who went into space was Yuri Gagarin, a Russian cosmonaut.
* '''Mikhail''': Russian for Michael, "who is like God?"
* '''Alexei''': Russian for Alexander or Alexis, meaning "protector of the men" in Greek. It is also more commonly written as Aleksei in Russia, instead of Alexei.
* '''Katerina''': Russian for Katherine, from the Greek adjective katharos 'pure', meaning pure, chaste.
* '''Natasha''': Russian for Natalie, which means "the one who was born on Christmas".

'''Nejem''': Possibly Arabic for "star".
* '''Darius''': it means "the powerful enemy" in Greek, and "our protector" in Persian. This is because of the war between Persia and Greece, and both meanings refer to the same person, King Darius.
* '''Jasmine''': it means "beautiful as the flower". It's a Persian name.
* '''Cyrus''': "the Great King" in Persian.
* '''Diana''': Latin for "full of divine light". It is the Roman equivalent of the Greek Artemis, the eternal virgin goddess, who lived in the forest with other nymphs. The twin of Apollo, daughter of Zeus and Leto.

'''Maximilian''': "great", "big", "the maximum" in Latin. It is also a name.
* '''Gloria''': literally glory, in Latin. With her surname, it may mean "The Maximum Glory".
* '''Vincent''': the winner, in Latin. With his surname, it may mean "The Maximum Winner".
All the family names, combined, may form: "The Maximum Glorious Winner", or "The Gloria of the Maximum Winner".

The '''Specter family''' (or '''Spector''' in [[Lunar Lakes]] and [[Oasis Landing]]) consists of [[Olive Specter|Olive]] and her niece [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia Nigmos]] in ''[[The Sims 2]]''. Olive also has a son, known only as [[Nervous Subject]]. Members of the Specter family also appear in ''The Sims 2''-related console games.

In ''[[The Sims 3]]'', there are different iterations of the Specter family. Olive appears with her toddler son before he's taken away by social workers. Also, it's revealed that in the future, the family name will be changed to Spector. [[Noela Spector|Noela]] and [[Planchette Spector|Planchette]] are confirmed as future descendants of this family.

In ''[[The Sims 4: Life & Death]]'', Olive and her son return, confirming that his birth name is Nyon Specter, and they live with her newest betrothed, [[Layne Coffin]].

==Main timeline biography==
===Before The Sims 3===
The only known members of the Specter family known to have lived before ''[[The Sims 2]]'' were [[Ichabod Specter|Ichabod]] and [[Billy Specter|Billy]]. Billy was a movie actor before his unfortunate passing during his [[adult]] [[life stage]], while Ichabod [[marriage|married]] the much more famous [[Olive Specter|Olive]], and is the only one of her husbands who [[death|died]] of natural causes. 

Later in life, Olive had a one-night stand with the [[Grim Reaper]], which resulted in the conception of her [[child]], who, according to ''[[The Sims 4]]'', took Ichabod's last name and was (initially) known as [[Nervous Subject|Nyon Specter]]. He was later renamed Nervous Subject, which is likely a nickname more than a real name.

===The Sims 3 (Midnight Hollow)===
The family's appearance in [[Midnight Hollow]] marks their earliest chronological appearance. A younger version of [[Olive Specter|Olive]] lives with her still [[toddler]] son, [[Nervous Subject]]. Her sister and parents are absent from this [[neighborhood]], but three of her ex-husbands are already buried in her cemetery. [[Rigger Mortis]], [[Hugh Thanasia]], and [[Ichabod Specter]] all have their [[gravestone]]s in Olive's lot in Midnight Hollow, although [[Earl E. DeMise|Earl E.]] is absent. It has been observed that the chronology of Olive's life is inconsistent between ''[[The Sims 3|Sims 3]]'' and ''[[The Sims 2|Sims 2]]'', as according to her ''Sims 2'' [[memories]], Earl E. was her ''first'' partner, and Ichabod did not pass away until ''after'' Nervous had been taken by the [[social worker]].

===The Sims 2 (PC game)===
[[Nervous Subject|Nervous]] was taken away from [[Olive Specter|Olive]] as a [[child]], for reasons which remain unknown, and lives with the [[Beaker family]]. His father is believed to be the [[Grim Reaper]], although there is no father shown in his [[family tree]]. When Olive [[death|dies]], her [[inheritance]] goes to Nervous instead of going to [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia]], the expected heir.<ref>Since inheritance in ''[[The Sims 2]]'' is separate from family funds, the family funds will pass to [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia]] as long as she is living on the lot when [[Olive Specter|Olive]] [[death|dies]].</ref>

When the family is first played, it is around 6:30 PM on Tuesday, two days before Ophelia will become an [[adult]], and two days before Olive is scheduled to die. While Tuesday is a [[bill]]-delivery day, there are no bills in the [[mailbox]]. The scripted instruction for this household will direct the player to let Olive [[pension|retire]]: 

''"Olive Specter wants to retire! Just pick up the phone and call work to start collecting that pension."''

Olive Specter and her deceased sister, [[Willow Nigmos]], were daughters of [[Lerato Muenda|Lerato]] and [[Peponi Muenda]].

Olive's memories show she was left at the altar when she was an adult, and the man who left her at the altar, [[Earl E. DeMise]], died shortly afterwards. She [[marriage|married]] many times after that, and all of her other husbands met an early end, as well. She was also the witness to several [[Non-playable character|NPC]] deaths, and their [[gravestone|graves]] remain on her lot. Their [[ghost]]s wreak havoc on the yard, causing many puddles and weeds to appear, showing that the ghosts are angry.

Ophelia is the daughter of the deceased [[Creon Nigmos|Creon]] and Willow. She was sent to live with Olive after their deaths. Olive and Ophelia's address is [[13 Dead End Lane]].

===The Sims 2 (Console games)===
[[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia Nigmos]] has adopted the Specter last name from her aunt in her [[adult]] life. She now resides in the [[Deadtree]] area of [[Strangetown]], having [[Inheritance|inherited]] a home from her mother's will. She has a contingency with another resident, [[Pita Florica]], who claims she is the real owner of her house.

[[Olive Specter|Olive]] is [[death|deceased]] by this time, and before the events of this game, [[Nervous Subject]] has died too due to the experiments from the [[Beaker family]]. He had a fiancée, [[Annie Howell]], but died before they could [[marriage|marry]], mirroring his mother's [[relationship|lovers]] who all died too soon.

Another Sim with this family name, [[Billy Specter]], appears in [[Sunset Canyon]]. He has a very bad temper and has negative or neutral [[relationship]]s with everyone. Since he's a [[ghost]], it's not clear how far back he places in the [[family tree]].

===The Sims 3 (Lunar Lakes)===
In ''[[The Sims 3]]'', a descendant of the family, named [[Noela Spector]], lives in [[Lunar Lakes]], one of the [[world]]s available for purchase from [[TheSims3.com#The Sims 3 Store|The Sims 3 Store]]. By this time, the family's name spelling has been changed from Spect''e''r to Spect''o''r. 

It remains unclear how a descendant of the Specter family came to exist. The only Sims known to be alive and associated with the Specter surname before the events of ''Lunar Lakes'' were [[Olive Specter|Olive]], [[Nervous Subject|Nyon]], and [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia]]. One possibility is that Olive [[adoption|adopted]] another [[child]] before her [[death]]. Alternatively, Nervous Subject may have impregnated [[Annie Howell]], and the [[pregnancy]] was simply not visible (as she appears in ''[[The Sims 2]]'' for [[The Sims 2 (console)|console]], a version known to lack the aging feature present in other [[The Sims (series)|Sims]] games). Another theory is that Ophelia had children with [[Johnny Smith]], and they chose to carry on the Specter surname. It is also possible that [[Ichabod Specter|Ichabod]], [[Billy Specter|Billy]], or Nyon were later resurrected and had children, or that there are other, as-yet-unrevealed members of the Specter family.

===The Sims 3 (Oasis Landing)===
The final appearance of the Specter/Spector family is in [[Oasis Landing]] in the [[Content pack#Expansion pack|expansion pack]] ''[[The Sims 3: Into the Future]]''. [[Planchette Spector]] is described as being the last living member of the Spector family, possibly meaning he's a descendant of [[Noela Spector|Noela]]. He lives in Oasis Landing with his [[Plumbot]], [[5P1R17]], whose serial number resembles the word 'spirit' in leet-speak. Planchette is also described as "an adventurous [[Sim]] who is desperate to open the door to the crashed ship. It's consumed his life and has nearly driven him to madness..." He is also said to have been returned from the [[death|dead]], meaning it's not clear when he was born and how he's placed in the [[family tree]].

Judging by the first and last names of some family members, the family may be of Greek and East African descent.

==The Sims 4 timeline biography==
It remains canon that [[Olive Specter]] had multiple husbands before her [[death]]. However, in this version of the storyline, her child was never taken away by [[social worker|social services]] and never had his name changed to [[Nervous Subject]]. Instead, he continues to live with Olive as a [[teen]]ager. The two currently reside in Ravenwood, where Olive is engaged to a new [[Sim]] named [[Layne Coffin]].

Recreations of Specter family members at later [[life stage|stages]] of their lives also appear in the Gallery. Olive is depicted as an [[elder]] living with her niece [[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia]], who, in this continuity, changed her surname to Specter during her teenage years.<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/bDh6lXgkEemDOnSkw70Zkw The Specter Family by Maxis]</ref> This change may be due to Gallery restrictions that prevent the upload of names containing the letter sequence "Nig," which also affected other Sims such as [[Nighat Caliente]].

Nervous Subject is also featured in a Gallery household, living with the [[Beaker family]]. This suggests that Nyon is once again doomed to be the subject of the same abusive conditions that his ''[[The Sims 2]]'' and ''[[The Sims 3]]'' counterparts had to endure. However, in this timeline, he becomes [[Loki Beaker|Loki]] and [[Circe Beaker|Circe]]'s test subject only after the birth of their children, [[Atom Beaker|Atom]] and [[Ceres Beaker|Ceres]], indicating that—unlike in previous versions—he was acquainted with them.

{{FamilyPage
|etymology = 
=== Specter/Spector family ===
*'''Specter''': [[Ghost]], or something that haunts the mind.
*'''[[Ichabod Specter|Ichabod]]''': Hebrew for 'without honor'. Could refer to the character Ichabod of Sleepy Hollow.
*'''[[Olive Specter|Olive]]Olive''' (Ichabod's widow): The olive tree. It is speculated that it is a pun on "o-live" in 'alive specter (ghost)'.
*'''[[Nervous Subject|Nyon]]''' (Olive's son): Variant of Neon, which is derived from Greek, meaning "new."
*'''[[Ophelia Specter|Ophelia]]''' (Olive's niece): In Ancient Greek, it means "help." May also refer to the Shakespeare character Ophelia from "Hamlet," who went mad and drowned herself.
*'''[[Noela Spector|Noela]]''' (An unlinked descendant): Derived from the Greek words "neos", meaning "new", and "laos", meaning "people". Alternatively, it could be a variant of the name "Nola", which is derived from the Irish name "Fionnuala" and means "white shoulder".
*'''[[Planchette Spector|Planchette]]''' (An unlinked descendant): A planchette is the name of a piece of wood designed to hold a pencil, used in séances to communicate with the spirits of the dead.

===Muenda family===
*'''Muenda''' -- Could refer to Munda, which is a place in the Solomon Islands. Muenda is also a traditional African name meaning "one who cares for others" in the Meru language. It also means "To go," in Swahili.
*'''[[Peponi Muenda|Peponi]]''' (Olive's father): Peponi means melon in Greek. It also means "paradise" in the Swahili language.
*'''[[Lerato Muenda|Lerato]]''' (Olive's mother): It means "love" in the Sotho language.
*'''[[Willow Nigmos|Willow]]''' (Olive's sister/Ophelia's mother): Refers to the Willow Tree. May also refer to willow as a word meaning erode as "willowing away."
*'''[[Earl E. DeMise]]''' (Olive's first fiancé): Means "Early Demise", early [[death]].
*'''[[Tim Lee DeMise]]''' (Earl's brother): Perhaps could refer to "Timely Demise" - "timely death."
*'''[[Rigger Mortis]]''' (Olive's first husband): "Rigger" means to rig or dress, while "Mortis" refers to the French word "mort", which means death. Rigor Mortis is a state in which a corpse's limbs become stiff and difficult to move.
*'''[[Hugh Thanasia]]''' (Olive's second husband): From the word "Euthanasia", which means literally "good death" in Ancient Greek. Refers to the practice of ending a life painlessly.
*'''[[Lou Thanasia]]''' (Hugh's brother): A shortening of the given name Louis. Louis means "Famed Warrior." Sounds similar to Hugh Thanasia, so could also mean "good death."
*'''Layne Coffin''' (Olive's fifth fiancé): Means "Lay in Coffin."

===Nigmos family===
*'''Nigmos''': Possibly taken from "enigma" - a mysterious occurrence, also means "a confusing character or person", which could refer to Olive herself.
*'''[[Creon Nigmos|Creon]]''' (Ophelia's father): In Greek, it means "ruler". Also, in [[wikipedia:Oedipus Rex|Oedipus Rex]], a character named [[wikipedia:Creon|Creon]]. Many of his relatives died: his grandnephews in a duel; his brother-in-law was murdered by Oedipus; his son, daughter-in-law, and sister by suicide, and he himself was murdered by [[wikipedia:Lycus of Euboea|Lycus]].
*'''[[Hecate Nigmos|Hecate]]''' (Creon's mother): Greek for far-shooting. Refers to the goddess of darkness, spirits, witchcraft, and the crossroads.
*'''[[Zog Nigmos|Zog]]''' (Creon's father): In Dutch, zog comes from "kielzog," which means wake, the white, turbulent water behind a boat.

An '''Imaginary Friend''' is a [[life state]] in ''[[The Sims 3: Generations]]'' and [[The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits|''The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits'']]. An Imaginary Friend begins its life as a magical doll that a newborn [[baby]] or a [[toddler]] may receive in the mail from a distant relative. Under the right conditions, the doll can come to life after its owner grows into a child.

==The Sims 3: Generations==
[[File:Imaginary Friend.png|50px|left]]
Introduced in The Sims 3: Generations; Imaginary Friends will go through up to three different forms throughout their lifespan, starting out as toys and potentially ending their lives as beings similar to regular Sims. In its initial form, an Imaginary Friend serves as an inanimate soft toy for a baby or toddler, much like a [[Wugglesworth Schnuggles Bear]]. During this stage, the Imaginary Friend can occasionally be seen teleporting around its home lot and changing poses if left outside a Sim's inventory, much like [[Mysterious Mr. Gnome]]. If a birthday party is thrown for its owner, the Imaginary Friend will usually automatically appear alongside the rest of the household as they watch the owner age up. Imaginary Friends in this form come in a variety of patterns, with either spots, stars, or stripes. There are twelve possible patterns in total.

All Imaginary Friends will begin with randomly-generated names. Players may rename the toy at any time during this stage, and in the process determine its future gender should it be turned real by specifying whether the new name is a male or female one. If the original name is left unchanged and the Imaginary Friend is later made real, its gender will be random.

If a toddler Sim plays with this initial toy form frequently and forms a sufficiently strong bond with it, the Imaginary Friend will transform into a living human-sized ragdoll-like creature with randomized [[Trait (The Sims 3)|traits]] once the toddler ages up into a child. The size of the Imaginary Friend in this second form will always correspond to that of its owner- it initially spawns as a child-sized NPC, and will grow larger on two more occasions after the owner reaches the [[Teen]] and [[Young Adult]] stages. At this point, the Imaginary Friend will only be visible when its owner is selected and cannot be seen or interacted with by most other Sims, much like the [[Social Bunny]] or the [[Therapist]] in ''[[The Sims 2]]''. Sims with Imaginary Friends in this form can, however, see Imaginary Friends belonging to other Sims.

When the owner of an Imaginary Friend leaves their home lot, goes to sleep or asks to be left alone, the Imaginary Friend will revert to its original toy form until the owner returns to the lot or attempts to interact with it again. Socializing with the Imaginary Friend in either of these forms raises the [[Social]] [[motive]] in the same way with ordinary Sims. In addition, the second form may be asked to fetch food or help them with chores. The player cannot directly control the Imaginary Friend at this stage, with only the Sim that owns it being able to influence its behavior by giving it commands.

From the child stage onwards, the Imaginary Friend may be converted into a real (if slightly inhuman-looking) Sim via the use of the Imaginary Friend Metamorphum potion. This third and final form can be seen and interacted with by all Sims, functions as a playable member of the household rather than an uncontrollable NPC and will always start out as the same life stage as its owner. By default, Imaginary Friends turned real will wear unusual clothing based on the colors and patterns of their first two forms, though they may later be given the same clothes as regular Sims if the player so desires.<ref>[http://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=de&tl=en&u=http://www.computerbild.de/artikel/cbs-News-Spiele-PC-Die-Sims-3-Lebensfreude-Interview-Ryan-Vaughan-EA-Electronic-Arts-6099746.html&rurl=translate.google.com&twu=1/ Translated by Google from German]</ref> Furthermore, Imaginary Friends turned real will frequently have abnormal hair and eye colors, which may be passed on to any children they later produce.

===Obtaining an Imaginary Friend===
[[File:Imaginary Friends.jpg|thumb|200px|A family of Imaginary friends?]]
There is a 75% chance that a package containing an Imaginary Friend doll will be delivered to an existing household soon after a new baby is born. The doll will immediately appear in the baby's inventory when another Sim goes to the mailbox to collect it. A baby may only receive one doll at most. If you create a toddler in CAS, it can also appear, but it has a smaller chance of getting the Imaginary Friend doll in their inventory after making it with a 50% chance.

===Getting rid of the doll===
If the player does not want a Sim to have an Imaginary Friend, but received one anyway, simply prevent its owner from forming a bond with it as a toddler by placing it in the inventory of another household member or cancelling any autonomous attempts to interact with it. Without a strong bond with its owner, the Imaginary Friend will remain an inanimate object. The Imaginary Friend doll cannot be sold in Build or Buy mode without mods, but can still be given away as a present to another child. As of [[patch 1.24]], Imaginary Friends can no longer be permanently buried in a sandbox and will eventually return if this is attempted. If ''[[Ambitions]]'' is installed, it is also not possible to [[detonate]] the Imaginary Friend doll. If ''[[Supernatural]]'' is installed, the doll can be transmuted into gold or stored in the Aleister’s Antique Alchemy Cabinet.

The Imaginary Friend doll can be deleted by using [[testingcheatsenabled]], shift-clicking the doll, and choosing the "Delete It" option.

Imaginary Friends turned real can be removed by installing the [https://www.nraas.net/community/MasterController MasterController] mod, deleting the imaginary friend using testingcheatsenabled, and then using MasterController to totally annihilate the name of the imaginary friend.<ref>https://www.nraas.net/community/Imaginary-Friend#How-do-I-delete-an-Imaginary-Friend-Doll-that-s-been-turned-real-and-stop-it-from-returning</ref>

===Making an Imaginary Friend real===
If a Sim has 8 or more points in [[Logic]] and owns the Catalyst Chemistry Lab Station, they can create the [[Potions#List of Potions|Imaginary Friend Metamorphium]] potion, which will turn an Imaginary Friend into a real Sim. The potion can also be acquired through an in-game [[opportunity]] at the [[Science lab]] if a Sim's relationship with their Imaginary Friend is at best friend. To complete this opportunity, a Rainbow Gem must be found and delivered to the science lab, after which the Imaginary Friend Metamorphium potion can be bought for §4500. After having created or bought the potion, the 'Offer to Make Real' interaction will no longer be grayed out when interacting with an Imaginary Friend, allowing the player to give the potion to them and turn them into a real Sim.

For the most part, Imaginary Friends turned real function in a similar manner to regular Sims in gameplay terms, being able to go to [[school]] or join [[careers]] and [[profession]]s (depending on their life stage) and unable to see other Imaginary Friends that have yet to become real. They can, however, switch back to their second human-sized ragdoll form at will, and always have the option of using the Imaginary Friend walk animation in addition to the standard Sim walk. They may also autonomously teleport to different locations on rare occasions, particularly if they get trapped. In addition, if an Imaginary Friend has only recently become real, they will gain positive moodlets for performing certain ordinary actions for the first time in their lives.

As they are still considered a non-human life state by the game, Imaginary Friends turned real will still cause a [[Celebrity]] to be publicly disgraced if they engage in [[WooHoo]] with them,{{Vgversion|TS3:LN}} and cannot be bitten by [[Vampire (The Sims 3)|Vampires]] or [[Werewolf|Werewolves]].{{Vgversion|TS3:SN}} Despite this, however, it is still possible for Imaginary Friends to interbreed with other life states and produce hybrid offspring.

If ''[[The Sims 3: World Adventures|World Adventures]]'' is installed and the Sims travel abroad before making any imaginary friends real, the original doll may "break" and Sims cannot interact with it.

===Offspring===
Despite their unnatural origins, Imaginary Friends turned real are no less capable of producing children than regular Sims. If a Sim successfully attempts to Try for Baby with an Imaginary Friend, there is a chance that the resulting offspring may inherit the hidden trait governing the abilities of Imaginary Friends as well as their unusual hair and eye genetics. Beyond the toddler stage, these children may transform into a human-sized ragdoll form and use a unique walk animation in the same manner as their non-human parent. This hidden trait does not, however, prevent the children of Imaginary Friends from having Imaginary Friends themselves.

===Exclusive things imaginary friends can do===
*An imaginary friend who has been turned real, can switch between a human mode, and their old plush mode in adult size.
*The ability to "Strut" while in human mode (in addition to it being the main walk in plush mode). Strut's walk speed is the [[Stride of Pride]], while its run speed is equivalent to a human's standard running speed, but with a cartoonish running posture, and without the Sim desiring to take a car or taxi instead of actually running.

===Notes===
*If resetsim [name of imaginary friend] is used on an Imaginary Friend that has yet to be turned real, it will disappear, but will not be deleted. Eventually they will return to their home lot in their third 'real' form, though they will still be invisible to other Sims on the property. This is most likely a bug.
*It is advisable to save prior to aging up a child or teenager with an Imaginary Friend, as there is a glitch that can cause the Imaginary Friend's aging up interaction to get stuck in the owner's queue and prevent them from performing further interactions afterwards.
* Imaginary Friends cannot be turned real in a full household of 8 Sims until another member of the household moves out or dies, or with the use of hacks, as Imaginary Friends turned real will take up a space in the household even though their first two forms do not.
*An Imaginary Friend turned real may only sleep in their regular Sim form, yet can still nap in their human-sized ragdoll form. For some reason, however, they can still sleep in a treehouse in either form.
*An Imaginary Friend turned real may only WooHoo in their regular Sim form. An Imaginary Friend that has yet to be turned real cannot WooHoo at all.

==The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits==
[[File:TS4 AA Imaginary Friend General Icon.png|left|60px]]
Imaginary friends were reintroduced in ''The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits''. Imaginary friends come in four types of dolls with their own unique personalities; each imaginary friend has their own way of interacting with their Sim based on their personality.

=== Obtaining an Imaginary Friend ===
Players can purchase an ImagineMe! doll from [[Build mode (The Sims 4)|Build mode]], the ImagineMe! doll will remain a doll that can be played with by children. When the child has reached level 3 of their [[Creativity (The Sims 4)|creativity]] skill as well has befriended the doll, they can select to make their doll turn into an imaginary friend. IF a child is feeling lonely, their imaginary friend doll will become an imaginary friend to befriend them.

By default the ImagineMe! doll will produce imaginary friends with certain personality traits:

Children, however, can always change their ImagineMe! doll's trait before they are turned into an imaginary friend the first time.

=== Having an Imaginary Friend ===
When a child or teen has an imaginary friend they have unique buffs while they're active, as well as lots of unique interactions with their imaginary friend. Imaginary friends are also only visible to the child similar to other child imagination animations such as the [[Monsters under bed|monster under the bed]] or with playing on a [[playground]].

Imaginary friends will exist on the lot for a period of time but when they have been out for too long or when their Sim goes to sleep, they will disappear into imaginary land. The Sim can always resummon their imaginary friend if need be. Whenever an imaginary friend is active, the Sim cannot interact or see their ImagineMe! doll, but everyone else can.

Imaginary friends behave differently depending on their selected trait:

[[File:Trait TS4 Goofball.png|left|30px]]Goofball Imaginary Friends love:

* Playing around and love mischief interactions with their Sim
* They love to joke around and being silly with their Sim
* They love playing with toys such as doll houses and tabletop games. When they want to play they will give suggestions on activities in notifications

[[File:Trait TS4 Creative.png|left|30px]]Creative Imaginary Friends love:

* Doing creative activities such as painting, papercrafting, activity tables, etc.
* They cheer on their Sim if they're doing creative activities
* They can boost creative skill gains in the presence of their Sim

[[File:Trait TS4 Evil.png|left|30px]]Evil Imaginary Friends love:

* Mean and pranking interactions
* They will enjoy when their Sim is being mean or malicious with them as well
* With enough bad influence Evil Imaginary Friends can make Sims gain the "Budding Evil Persona" bonus trait which will convert into a bonus evil trait when they age into young adults
* Evil Imaginary Friends can also teach their Sim how to start fires.

[[File:Trait TS4 Competitive.png|left|30px]]Competitive Imaginary Friends love:

* Playing competitive games
* They will win more often playing games against their Sim
* When Sims win against a competitive imaginary friend, they will gain a confident buff moodlet


=== Benefits from Imaginary Friends ===
Sims can have all the normal social interactions with their imaginary friend but they also have the unique ability to "Imaginary Boost" their Sim; this will grant special moodlets based on their personality. When an imaginary friend and their Sim become good friends, they can become "Friends to the End" unlocking a unique handshake with their Sim that grants a playful moodlet.

When a child completes the "Have a Best Friend Imaginary Friend" formative moment, they can gain unique traits based on their imaginary friend's trait;

* Goofball imaginary friends help the Sim will have more success with prank interactions
* Creative imaginary friends help the Sim with leveling up their creative skills
* Evil imaginary friends help the Sim's mean interactions succeed more
* Competitive imaginary friends will give boosts to the Sim's confident moodlets

===Making an Imaginary Friend real===
[[File:TS4 AA Imaginary friends real versions.png|thumb]]
Sims who have an imaginary friend and reach their [[teen]] age; they can turn their imaginary friends real with a special interaction, their human appearance is dictated by their doll form.

When made real, imaginary friends exist as completely normal human Sims and do not bear any other traits from their imaginary forms. They will also be added to the household once made real.

===Saying Goodbye===
At any time a child or teen Sim can say goodbye to their imaginary friend forever. This will be a permanent interaction with that specific imaginary friend where they will disappear and can no longer come back to life. When the interaction is done Sims will cry in their absence but the imaginary friend remains positive.

If the Sim has said goodbye forever to their imaginary friend, they cannot offer to make them real.
