==Social==
===[[file:Ravenwood Rumors.png|30px|link=]] Ravenwood Rumors===
Layne, like other citizens of Ravenwood, has a special interaction called ''Ravenwood Rumors'' that reveals tidbits of lore relating to himself, his ancestry, or the town's history. Depending on your relationship level with Layne, different secrets will be revealed.

====0-32 Relationship Points====
*"If you stop by the Baleful Bog, you can temporarily become a [[Ghost]]. I've got a pet Death Frog for a similar reason, though I confess: it makes me feel a little odd to merely pretend to be a ghost. My motto as a musician is that if you're gonna go for it, you should go all the way!"
*"Can you believe that when Olive and I first met up - at the cemetery, naturally - she had no idea I'm a musician? It was refreshing to run into someone who doesn't know you before they know you."
*"I've always felt a strange pull towards death. It never felt right to admit, but what I was drawn towards wasn't just the, well, grim idea of death so much as the potency of seeing a spectrum of existence around it. There's an event, Celebration of Life, that happens in Crow's Crossing sometimes. I'll visit to get a taste of the other side of death; the moment when the living gather to bask in remembrances of you."

====33-65 Relationship Points====
*"[[Radwan Gomes|Radwan]] and I used to date way back when, you know. He's a sweet guy, but in the end we just weren't totally compatible. I think he wanted to settle down into a quiet family life. Funny how things turn out; his settled down family life involves that absolute whirlwind of a woman, [[Tziporah Gomes|Tziporah]]. They make a great couple, though."
*"I've noticed those [[Specter|little green fellas]] over by the swing sets in [[Crow's Crossing]], and I've also noticed that a couple houses elsewhere here seem to have a lot going on. I'm dying, practically ''dying'', to spend time in haunted places."

====66-100 Relationship Points====
*"Have you ever dabbled in [[Thanatology]]? I find it fascinating; I suppose it just lends an even more mysterious air to me, but I can’t help but find it compelling. You’ve heard that you can eventually make Soul Soup, yes?"
*"I’m highly competitive, had I told you that before? The thought of a game where your very life hangs in the balance is maybe a little bit more thrilling than it should be for a guy like me. I’d heard that you could challenge [[Grim Reaper|Grim]] himself to a chess game. But, as I said, I’m competitive. I seem to have a real knack for winning, for good or ill."
*I suppose you've been talking to other Sims about me, huh. I can sort of tell. People will whisper about me a lot when I'm out with Olive. If they're scandalized, too bad!

=== Secret Confession ===
If you become good friends with Layne (and have also heard a Ravenwood Rumor about him and Olive from Nyon, Zelmira, or Zuleika), he will call you and ask if he can tell you a secret. If you accept, he will tell you that he is an evil Sim and his [[Good (The Sims 4)|good]] trait will be replaced by the [[Evil (The Sims 4)|evil]] trait.
*"Yeah, so, I noticed the grave for [[Hugh Thanasia]] a while before I even started seeing Olive. Did you know: more than anything, I want to be a Ghost, too! So the thought of Olive “helping” me is, well, kismet, right? Cuz you see, while I didn’t really lie to you about who I am... I also didn’t quite tell you the truth. I was hiding the fact that I’m an Evil Sim, but now you know. It doesn’t mean we’re not still close friends; if anything, I feel closer to you than ever! I hope I’m not too Evil for ya, though."

Past 70 friendship points, he will have new Ravenwood Rumors to share.
*"I hope you don't feel like you got the rug yanked out from under you. I wouldn't have talked to you about who I am if I didn't like you and trust you. I guess I'm just a bit weirder than expected, though, right?"
*"I was out for a stroll and caught a ghost Sim using their abilities right out in the street. It tickles me a little to see them possess musical objects, which I’ve also seen when invited over to spend time with a ghost. It’s hard not to envy powers like those."
*"Do you even hear an inner voice telling you to be mean? I mean, certainly that’s something every Sim experiences, isn’t it? But how often is the real question, isn’t it?"

==Trivia==
* His name is a pun of "lay in coffin".
* Also, the combination of his first name and musician career suggests possible reference to {{WP|Layne Staley}}.

Celeste is a [[young adult]], 28 days away from becoming an [[adult]]. She also has appeared in several promotional materials for ''Growing Together'', as well as the reveal trailer. While having no relatives in-game, her father, [[Sebastian Michaelson|Sebastian]], who appeared in the Gameplay trailer, was made available to download separately from the [[The Sims 4 Gallery|Gallery]].

Celeste is the first pre-made Sim in the history of the series to be officially recognized as transgender and referred to as such.

===[[file:San Sequoia Secrets Icon.png|30px|link=]] San Sequoia Secrets===
Like other San Sequoia townies, Celeste has a special interaction under Friendly/Gossip called ''"San Sequoia Secrets"'' that will reveal tidbits of lore pertaining to her personal history or the town's history. Depending on your relationship level with Celeste, different secrets will be revealed.

====0–32 Relationship Points====
*"Have you been to [[Gilbert Gardens]] yet? The gazebo is my favorite part; my spouse, [[Christopher Michaelson|Christopher]], proposed to me right in front of it!"
*"My son, [[Atlas Michaelson|Atlas]], has been talking over and over about how he wants to learn how to ride a bike. I can't wait to teach him, but I can't help but remember some of the times I had trouble learning myself as a kid."
*"[[Doli Ruano]] and I have been friends for a while. Just because she's mega-goth doesn't mean she's out of touch with fashion, and she's always the first one I go to for style tips."
*"Last year, Christopher surprised me with a his-and-hers gaming setup for our house. I love gaming with him—though I am definitely mega-competitive."
*"I used to live by myself in [[Anchorpoint Wharf]] for a while, but I have to be honest and say that I like it out here in [[Hopewell Hills]]. It's a nice, calm place to raise my kids."

====33–65 Relationship Points====
*"They added a little splashpad to the park not all that long ago. Believe it or not, the person we have to thank for that one is Ignacio Robles. He gets really involved in city business, and he kept saying there aren't enough things for kids with families to do around here, so he wanted that built up. It was so sweet of him. Atlas loves it there!"
*"When Christopher and I got married, we went to [[Tartosa]]—I'm old acquaintances with [[Camille Soto]], do you know her? Anyway, we had a galaxy-themed cake at our wedding because, well, I'm kind of into astronomy, if that wasn't obvious!"
*"Atlas was such a quiet baby that I guess I expected [[Orion Michaelson|Orion]] to be the same, but I guess things really do vary one child to the next. When Orion's awake, she's interested in everything and anything and does not want to sit still or be ignored. Keeping an eye on her is a full time job."
*"I started losing my teeth as a child before Atlas did; it's interesting to see how much that varies person-to-person. I was so excited to get that money from the tooth fairy, though!"

====66–100 Relationship Points====
*"It's not a secret, but I still prefer not to talk about it with people I don't know as well. I came out as trans just before we adopted Atlas. I'd been thinking about it for a long time but hadn't said anything to anyone until I blurted it out to my friend, Doli, and she just said: ''if you feel like you are, maybe you should embrace the idea that you are a woman.'' I already knew in my heart who I really was, but that early support from her and from my husband meant everything."
*"This is way more gossip-y than I like to get, but did you know [[Xochitl Luna]]'s husband died while cooking Gummy Bear Pancakes? Xochitl is just so nice; we've all felt just awful about it since it happened."
*"It's pretty out here but I hear there used to be a lot more trees in the whole area. I guess when they were developing things, they cut down a lot of them. I'm a tech-y person so trust me, I love all the latest gadgets, but sometimes you do wonder what we're losing when we're racing forward all the time."

==Trivia==
*Despite mentioning Doli Ruano to be her best friend, the two do not know one another when starting the game.
**In the game's files, a [[Pre-made (The Sims 4)|Pre-mades]] Setup between [[Ian Robles]] and Celeste Michaelson can be found even though any relationship between the two is never mentioned in any gossips. It is possible that this setup was meant to be between Celeste and Doli, and the developers simply made a mistake.
*Within the game's files, Celeste's name is "Adhara Michaelson" sometimes.
*Based on her first name and gender identity, she may be a tribute to the game ''[[w:c:celestegame:Celeste|Celeste]]'', which has a transgender protagonist.

'''Malcolm Landgraab III''' is one of the pre-made [[death|deceased]] ancestral [[Sim]]s who resided during his lifetime in [[Bluewater Village]], the shopping district shipped with ''[[The Sims 2: Open for Business]]''. He was the son of [[Malcolm Landgraab II|Malcolm II]] and [[Marion Landgraab|Marion]], the husband of [[Margaret Landgraab|Margaret]] {{Nee|Buckingham}}, and the father of [[Malcolm Landgraab IV|Malcolm IV]].

Malcolm III is completely resurrectable, even though he doesn't have a [[gravestone|grave]]. He has [[personality]] points and [[interest]]s, something not every ancestral Sim has. Malcolm III has the [[Fortune]] [[Aspiration (The Sims 2)|aspiration]] and the Aries [[zodiac sign]]. As far as personality, he is very outgoing, quite active, and somewhat neat, but quite serious and rather grouchy.

According to Malcolm III's age data in [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]], he had 29 days left in the [[adult]] [[life stage]] when he died. He has a [[memories|memory]] of the death of his father-in-law, [[Blair Buckingham]]. According to the other [[Landgraab family|family members]]' memories, Malcolm III was the first Sim in the family to die. He and his wife died prematurely when their son was a [[child]], based on [[family relationships|family]] photos, leaving him to be raised by his paternal grandparents. However, he doesn't have any memories of his ancestors.

His name is technically spelled "Malcolm ", with an extra space, making his technical name "Malcolm  Landgraab III". His father and son also have this case. Malcolm III uses a customized variation of a pre-made CAS face already in [[Create a Sim]], for the second skin tone for adult males with the short blond hair and gray eyes.

The translation description for her given name mentions that it was copied from Live.package. For the last name, it mentions that it was copied from Live.package. Japanese, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (traditional), Thai, and Korean refer to him as the fourth, like his son.

'''Morgyn Ember''' is a pre-made [[Non-playable character|NPC]] [[spellcaster]] residing as the default [[Sage]] of Untamed Magic in [[The Magic Realm]], the hidden [[neighborhood]] shipped with ''[[The Sims 4: Realm of Magic]]''.

Morgyn is a [[young adult]], 28 days away from becoming an [[adult]]. Their spellcaster rank is Virtuoso, the highest rank. They are the only pre-made Sim from the pack who has no skills. They have a masculine frame, a preference for feminine clothing, are unable to become pregnant or get other Sims pregnant, and cannot use the toilet standing up.

A new Sage of Untamed Magic will be generated to take Morgyn's place if they die or are moved into a household. According to the trailer, Morgyn was preceded by [[Tess Dyer]] as the Sage of Untamed Magic.   

==Gender Identity==
Morgyn's gender settings are customized in [[Create a Sim]] with the inability to get pregnant or get anyone pregnant, and having a feminine clothing preference. This led to some disagreements within the community about whether or not Morgyn is (or is intended to be) non-binary, transgender, and/or intersex.  

''The Sims 4'' does not include the option to place Sims outside of the male/female binary. Fundamentally, all Sims in ''The Sims 4'' are, according to the game code, either male or female, regardless of further gender customization. Within the game, Morgyn is recognized as male. Whether [[Maxis]] intended for Morgyn to be a specific gender identity like non-binary, transgender, and/or intersex is unknown, aside from Morgyn's pronouns being "they/them."

Many simmers have referred to Morgyn with the pronouns "they/them" since the release of the ''Realm of Magic'' game pack. [[The Sims 4/Patch 129|Patch 129]] added the ability to select what pronouns a Sim uses. In this patch, Morgyn's pronouns were not explicitly set, and the gender's default was used (which is masculine, in Morgyn's case). As of [[The Sims 4/Patch 150|Patch 150]], Morgyn's pronouns are "they/them" in new saves, if the game language is set to English. In conclusion, they are non-binary.

Morgyn's card in [[The Sims Board Game]] explicitly refers to them as non-binary.<ref>'''[https://youtu.be/BFOAdZCjiUE?si=nYFASiflJgwe0-6u&t=310 The Sims Board Game - How to Play]'''</ref>

==Biography==
Johnny is a [[young adult]], 28 days away from becoming an [[adult]].

==Family controversy==
According to Johnny's family bio, he was a member of the [[Landgraab family]] but was disowned after dropping out of school to follow his dreams of being an entertainer. Possibly due to an oversight and lack of family trees at the time of release, his relatives did not know him at all, and the game did not internally recognize their familial relation. This could cause a bit of chaos, as with [[story progression]] enabled, he could have entered a relationship with and married other Landgraabs. This issue was addressed in [[The Sims 4/Patch 193|patch 193]], and Johnny will now be recognized as family by the Landgraabs. Despite Johnny's family bio stating he is disowned, he is friends with his parents and does not know of his brother; this is most likely an oversight.

Prior to patch 193, the common assumption amongst players was that Johnny is the son of [[Nancy Landgraab|Nancy]] and [[Geoffrey Landgraab]],<ref>[https://forums.thesims.com/en_us/discussion/974860/who-is-johny-zest-to-the-landgraabs Simmers discussing the Landgraab lore in The Sims Forum]</ref> which was confirmed by the Sims Team in the countdown before the [[The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy]] trailer reveal. A photograph of him being held by Nancy as an [[infant]] was used to promote the release of ''[[The Sims 4: Growing Together|Growing Together]]''; however, the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alt_attribute alt text] of the image neutrally labels her as "a relative" rather than his mother.<ref>[https://twitter.com/TheSims/status/1634252894625996833/photo/3 Johnny as an infant being held by Nancy (Twitter)]</ref>

==Trivia==
* Due to a bug, Johnny's first and last name would sometimes switch, causing him to be called "Zest Johnny" instead of Johnny Zest. However, this was fixed in [[The Sims 4/Patch 10|patch 10]].
* He may have been designed loosely after the titular character from the cartoon ''[[wikipedia:Johnny Test|Johnny Test]]'', in terms of outfit choice, chatty, playful personality, and body features
* In ''[[Kits for The Sims 4|The Sims 4: Industrial Loft Kit]]'', two item descriptions say that after the Landgraab family disowned Johnny Zest, he had no possessions or money to buy furniture, so he had to be resourceful. Sure, he could have gone to the thrift shop, but there's no fun in that. Instead, Johnny went to one of his family's construction sites, swiped building supplies, and cobbled together a big, squishy sofa that could rival anything bought in a fancy upscale furniture store. Hopefully, he cleaned the pipes before assembling. He also built a surprisingly comfortable chair. Functional, comfortable revenge is the best kind!
* Johnny's lifestyle and background have some similarities to ''The Sims''<nowiki>'</nowiki> [[Dudley Landgraab]]. They have both been disowned by the Landgraabs and live in trailer homes within a sand-covered region. The main difference is that Johnny is [[Ambitious (The Sims 4)|career ambitious]], while Dudley is not. This may suggest that it is common for the Landgraabs to disown any Sims who don't conform to family ideals.
